rows.s: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award.
rows.zh: 一群工党议员——其中包括伊薇特·库珀——正以一项设立英国"文化之镇"奖的呼吁来迎接新的一年。

rows.s: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
rows.zh: 同样明智的是，我们应记住：这类称号并非万能良药。

rows.s: A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
rows.zh: 一场办砸了的"文化之年"会像潮水般涌入一个地方又退去，短暂地带来名气，却没有给当地社区留下任何持久的益处。

rows.s: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
rows.zh: 这类称号真正成功的获得者，远不只是填满酒店客房、在一年里引进高水准的艺术活动和赢得良好的媒体口碑而已。

rows.s: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
rows.zh: 它们改变了当地居民的抱负；它们把这座城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的境地。

rows.s: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
rows.zh: 这件事很难做好，需要非凡的远见，以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化机构之间的通力合作。

rows.s: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations, at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
rows.zh: 科学出版商照例报告其业务上接近40%的利润率，而此时出版业的其他部分正处于生存危机之中。

rows.s: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
rows.zh: 由于论文内容是免费获得的，出版商只需为其期刊找到市场即可。

rows.s: These range from around £500 to $5,000, and apparently the work gets more expensive the more that publishers do it.
rows.zh: 这些费用从约500英镑到5000美元不等，而且显然出版商做得越多，这项工作就越昂贵。

rows.s: Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.
rows.zh: 直到本世纪之前，大学图书馆对价格都不太敏感。

rows.s: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.
rows.zh: 科学出版长期以来一直是一张印钞许可证（即一门稳赚不赔的生意）。

rows.s: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies.
rows.zh: 在英国，迈向开放获取出版的进程一直是由资助机构推动的。

rows.s: In some ways it has been very successful.
rows.zh: 在某些方面，它一直非常成功。

rows.s: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
rows.zh: 如今，超过一半的英国科学研究都是按开放获取条款发表的：要么自发表之时起便可免费获取，要么被设置付费墙一年或更久，以便出版商在内容公开发布之前获利。

rows.s: Yet the new system has not yet worked out any cheaper for the universities.
rows.zh: 然而，对各大学而言，这套新体系尚未被证明能省下任何钱。

rows.s: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.
rows.zh: 出版商对让其产品对读者免费这一要求做出了回应——办法是向作者收取费用，以弥补准备一篇文章的成本。

rows.s: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.
rows.zh: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费和这些“文章准备费”的成本都一直以高于通胀的速度稳步上升。

rows.s: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
rows.zh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式类似于社交互联网的经济：劳动被无偿提供，以换取对地位的期望，而巨额利润却由少数几家经营这些市场平台的大公司赚取。

rows.s: In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.
rows.zh: 在这两种情况下，我们都需要一种权力的再平衡。

rows.s: Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.
rows.zh: 科学家需要可供发表其研究成果的期刊，因此他们会无偿提供文章。

rows.s: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
rows.zh: 其他科学家也无偿从事同行评审这项专门工作，因为它是获取地位和产出科学知识过程中的一个核心要素。

rows.s: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
rows.zh: Sci-Hub依赖研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的副本，它的成功表明，这个合法的生态系统已在其用户中失去了合法性，必须加以变革，以便惠及所有参与者。

rows.s: The most drastic, an thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
rows.zh: 最为激烈、且完全非法的反应，便是Sci-Hub的出现——这是一种面向科学论文的全球复印机，创建于2012年，如今声称能提供自2015年以来发表的每一篇付费墙文章的访问权。

rows.s: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210 m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
rows.zh: 荷兰巨头爱思唯尔声称发表了全世界所产出科学论文的25%，去年赚取了逾9亿英镑的利润，而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了逾2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够访问他们自己的由公共资金资助的研究成果；尽管人们做出了愈发拼命的努力来改变这两个数字，它们似乎仍在不可阻挡地上升。

rows.s: But are such government mandates even necessary?
rows.zh: 但这类政府强制规定真的有必要吗？

rows.s: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
rows.zh: 公司董事会中的女性参与度目前或许并不能反映总人口中的女性比例，但那又如何呢？

rows.s: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference.
rows.zh: 在没有政府干预的情况下，公司董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步增加。

rows.s: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
rows.zh: 根据Catalyst的一项研究，在2010年至2015年间，全球性公司董事会中的女性比例增加了54%。

rows.s: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
rows.zh: 要求公司将性别作为董事会成员资格的首要条件，将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会经验更为欠缺。

rows.s: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
rows.zh: 那正是挪威实行全国性公司性别配额时所发生的情况。

rows.s: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
rows.zh: 爱丽丝·李在《新共和》杂志撰文指出，在不扩大有资格在此类董事会任职的女性储备的情况下增加董事会席位的机会数量，已经导致出现一种“金裙”现象，即同一批精英女性在各类董事会中揽得多个席位。

rows.s: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
rows.zh: 但这类政策往往只是一种虚伪的道德标榜形式，只惠及最享有特权的人，对帮助普通人却几乎毫无作用。

rows.s: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
rows.zh: 由马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德提出、旨在确保董事会和委员会中“性别均等”的一对议案，便是一个恰当的例证。

rows.s: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
rows.zh: 哈达德和刘易斯担忧的是，超过半数的州政府董事会中女性所占比例不足40%。

rows.s: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
rows.zh: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议实施政府配额。

rows.s: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
rows.zh: 如果这些议案成为法律，各州董事会和委员会将被要求在2022年前为女性预留50%的董事席位。

rows.s: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
rows.zh: 在签署该措施时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确以性别为依据对人进行分类的法律很可能违宪。

rows.s: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest, Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
rows.zh: 美国最高法院反对基于性别的分类，除非这些分类是为了应对某种“重要的”政策利益而设。由于加州法律适用于所有董事会，甚至适用于此前并无歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能裁定该法律违反了宪法对“平等保护”的保障。

rows.s: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
rows.zh: 这些议案与加利福尼亚州近期通过的一项措施相似，该州去年成为首个对私营企业强制实行性别配额的州。

rows.s: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
rows.zh: 下次再有人将公司配额鼓吹为促进性别公平的一种方式时，请记住：这类政策在很大程度上是自利之举，它让其倡导者自我感觉良好，却几乎无助于普通女性。

rows.s: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
rows.zh: 进步派常常支持多样性强制规定，将其视为通往平等的途径，以及创造公平竞争环境的一种方式。

rows.s: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
rows.zh: 法国和美国都参与了该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税和美国的回应引发了关于国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

rows.s: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
rows.zh: 但它已经引发了重大争议，美国贸易代表已就该税是否歧视美国公司展开调查，而这反过来可能导致针对法国的贸易制裁。

rows.s: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
rows.zh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税。

rows.s: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
rows.zh: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国和其他几个国家都认真考虑过征收数字服务税。

rows.s: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
rows.zh: 法国计划征收的这项税是一个明确的警示：除非能就改革国际税收体系达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会效仿跟进，而美国公司将面对来自数十个国家的一连串各不相同的税，这些税将被证明既繁重又昂贵。

rows.s: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
rows.zh: 数字服务涵盖了从为在线销售商品和服务提供平台、到基于用户数据进行定向广告投放的一切，而该税则适用于来自此类服务的总收入。

rows.s: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "
rows.zh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体把这称为一种“……”

rows.s: GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
rows.zh: （被称为）“GAFA 税”，意思是它主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司，换句话说，即总部位于美国的跨国科技公司。

rows.s: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
rows.zh: 数字服务税如今正等待埃马纽埃尔·马克龙总统的签署，他已表示支持这项举措，而该税可能在未来几周内生效。

rows.s: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
rows.zh: 法国的这项税并不只是某个亟需财政收入的国家所采取的单边行动。

rows.s: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
rows.zh: 相反，数字服务税是一个大得多的趋势的一部分，过去几年里各国纷纷提出或推行了一大堆名目繁多的新国际税收条款。

rows.s: They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
rows.zh: 举几个例子来说，它们包括英国的 DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的 MAAL（跨国反避税法）和印度的 SEP（重大经济存在）测试。

rows.s: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
rows.zh: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各不相同，但它们都旨在就各国认为自己有权征税的所得和收入向跨国公司征税，即便国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。

rows.s: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
rows.zh: 换句话说，他们全都持有这样一种观点：国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

rows.s: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
rows.zh: 为应对这许多单边举措，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正与 131 个国家合作，以便在 2020 年底前就一项国际解决方案达成共识。

rows.s: In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company.
rows.zh: 在法国，持有某家公司投资至少两年的股东，有时能在该公司获得更多的投票权。

rows.s: Within companies, the right compensation design can provide incentives for executives to think beyond their own time at the company and on behalf of all stakeholders.
rows.zh: 在公司内部，恰当的薪酬设计能够为高管提供激励，促使他们把眼光放到自己任期之外，并代表所有利益相关者去思考。

rows.s: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
rows.zh: 英国的新规定提醒银行家们：社会对他们的业绩抱有利益关切，这种关切不仅着眼于短期，更着眼于长期。

rows.s: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
rows.zh: 从明年开始，如果高管所在的银行因不当行为正受到调查，那么他们任何有保障的奖金都可能被延迟10年发放。

rows.s: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
rows.zh: 这项“追回”（clawback）规定的主要目的，是让银行家为有害的冒险行为负责，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。

rows.s: Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations.
rows.zh: 然而官员们还期望获得一个大得多的好处：更多的长期决策——不仅出自银行，而且出自所有公司——从而为子孙后代建立起更强大的经济。

rows.s: "Short-termism," or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane.
rows.zh: 英格兰银行首席经济学家安德鲁·霍尔丹表示，“短期主义”，即对快速利润的渴望，在上市公司中已经愈演愈烈。

rows.s: He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
rows.zh: 他引用古典经济学巨匠阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话，把这种金融上的急躁描述为像“把布丁里的李子挑出来立刻吃掉、而不是留到最后吃的孩子”那样行事。

rows.s: "There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
rows.zh: 美国证券交易委员会委员丹尼尔·加拉格尔本周在一次演讲中说：“似乎存在一种以牺牲长期投资为代价、短期思维占主导的现象。”

rows.s: The average time for holding a stock in both the United States and Britain, he notes, has dropped from seven years to seven months in recent decades.
rows.zh: 他指出，近几十年来，在美国和英国持有一只股票的平均时间已从七年缩短到了七个月。

rows.s: Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty.
rows.zh: 要求公司提供高额季度利润的短线投资者，会妨碍公司投资长期研究或培养客户忠诚度的种种努力。

rows.s: This has been dubbed "quarterly capitalism."
rows.zh: 这种现象被称为“季度资本主义”。

rows.s: In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets.
rows.zh: 此外，新的数字技术使股票交易更为迅速、信息使用更为快捷，从而也使金融市场中的注意力持续时间变得更短。

rows.s: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks.
rows.zh: 英国的金融监管机构对各大银行的高管们施加了一项相当不同寻常的规定。

rows.s: In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce "short-termism."
rows.zh: 在美国，2002年的《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》已促使大多数上市公司将高管的绩效奖金推迟大约一年发放，从而略微有助于减少"短期主义"。

rows.s: In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
rows.zh: 《华尔街日报》在其最新的CEO薪酬调查中发现，高管薪酬中“相当大的一部分”如今已与绩效挂钩。

rows.s: Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions.
rows.zh: 本可以采取更多措施来鼓励“长期主义”，例如修改税法以及更快地披露股票收购情况。

rows.s: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
rows.zh: 但如今大多数高校（许多选拔性强的院校除外）允许所有本科生、甚至研究生让自己的低分得到宽恕。

rows.s: When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses.
rows.zh: 几十年前这一做法刚开始时，通常仅限于大一新生，目的是在他们向大学水平课程过渡遇到困难时，给他们第二次机会在第一年里重修一门课。

rows.s: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
rows.zh: 这一鲜为人知的做法近年来使用日益增多，因为各高校继续竭尽全力把学生留在校内（并继续缴纳学费），并提高其毕业率。

rows.s: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student's overall GPA.
rows.zh: 分数宽恕允许学生重修一门他们曾得了低分的课程，而最近一次的成绩或最高的成绩才是计算学生总绩点时唯一算数的成绩。

rows.s: But another, related force—a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness"—is helping raise GPAs.
rows.zh: 但另一种相关的力量——一种常常深藏于课程目录中、被称为"成绩宽恕"的政策——正在帮助拉高平均学分绩点。

rows.s: Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible—or at least appear to be.
rows.zh: 既然学生和家长都期望大学学位能带来一份工作，那么培养出尽可能合格、或至少看上去合格的毕业生便符合学校的最大利益。

rows.s: On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
rows.zh: 在这一点上，学生与高校的动机似乎是一致的。

rows.s: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
rows.zh: 事实上，分数宽恕只是大学回应消费者对高等教育期望的又一种方式。

rows.s: And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students – who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill—feel they've gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges.
rows.zh: 而且，任何能提高绩点的东西都很可能让学生——归根结底是付账的人——觉得他们的学费物超所值，而这正是高校另一项重大关切。

rows.s: For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention—so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money.
rows.zh: 对公立院校而言，州拨款有时部分地与其在毕业率、学生保留率等指标上的表现挂钩——因此更好的成绩可以通过提升这类数字而带来更多的资金。

rows.s: Grade inflation—the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades—is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.
rows.zh: 分数膨胀——即过去几十年里平均绩点（GPA）的逐渐上升——常被视为高等教育消费时代的产物，在这个时代里，学生被当作需要取悦的顾客来对待。

rows.s: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges' own needs as well.
rows.zh: 话虽如此，分数宽恕也存在一种同样满足高校自身需求的方式。

rows.s: "Ultimately," said Jack Miner, Ohio State University's registrar, "we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time."
rows.zh: 俄亥俄州立大学的教务主任杰克·迈纳说：“归根结底，我们看到学生取得了更多成功，因为他们重修一门课程，在后续课程中表现更好，或者掌握了使他们能够按时毕业的内容。”

rows.s: College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.
rows.zh: 高校官员往往强调，分数宽恕的目的不在于成绩本身，而更在于鼓励学生重修那些对其学位项目和毕业至关重要的课程，且不必为此承受很大的代价。

rows.s: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist.
rows.zh: 斯坦福大学神经科学家戴维·伊格曼说，人类究竟如何思考至今仍过于复杂而难以被理解，更遑论复制。

rows.s: "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there."
rows.zh: “我们正处于这样一种境地：没有任何完善的理论能够解释意识究竟是什么，以及人们究竟如何才能造出一台机器去实现意识。”

rows.s: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand.
rows.zh: 但这并不意味着涉及人工智能的关键伦理问题不会很快到来。

rows.s: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
rows.zh: 例如，自动驾驶汽车即将到来的应用就带来了棘手的伦理问题。

rows.s: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, by Mary Shelley.
rows.zh: 今年恰好标志着玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦；或现代普罗米修斯》出版整整两个世纪。

rows.s: Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions.
rows.zh: 人类驾驶员有时必须在瞬间做出决定。

rows.s: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
rows.zh: 他们的反应可能是即时反射、以往驾驶经验所提供的信息，以及当下耳闻目睹所传达的信息的复杂综合。

rows.s: AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
rows.zh: 如今人工智能的“视觉”远不如人类的视觉那般精密。

rows.s: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
rows.zh: 而且，要预测每一种可以想象到的驾驶情境，是一个艰难的编程难题。

rows.s: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
rows.zh: 与新加坡一道，其他各国政府和大型企业也开始制定各自的准则。

rows.s: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
rows.zh: “每当决策建立在海量数据之上时，你就会很快陷入大量的伦理问题，”一家总部设在新加坡、正协助政府制定人工智能合乎伦理使用自愿准则的机构的首席执行官陈杰豪指出。

rows.s: Britain is setting up a data ethics center.
rows.zh: 英国正在设立一个数据伦理中心。

rows.s: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
rows.zh: 印度于今年春天发布了其人工智能伦理战略。

rows.s: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
rows.zh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会“设计或部署”会造成“整体危害”的人工智能，也不会开发由人工智能操控的武器，或将人工智能用于会违反国际准则的监控。

rows.s: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
rows.zh: 甚至早在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者就创作了一部非凡的推想小说，它预示了许多将由尚未到来的技术所引发的伦理问题。

rows.s: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
rows.zh: 它还承诺不会部署其使用会违反国际法或人权的人工智能。

rows.s: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
rows.zh: 尽管这份声明含糊不清，但它代表着一个起点。

rows.s: So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
rows.zh: “由人工智能系统做出的决策应当可解释、透明且公正”这一理念也同样代表着一个起点。

rows.s: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
rows.zh: 换句话说：我们如何才能确保智能机器的思维反映出人类的最高价值观？

rows.s: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.
rows.zh: 只有到那时，它们才会成为有用的仆人，而不会变成弗兰肯斯坦那失控的怪物。

rows.s: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness?
rows.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性的问题：“何为智能、身份或意识？”

rows.s: What makes humans humans?"
rows.zh: 是什么使人之为人？”

rows.s: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists.
rows.zh: 所谓的通用人工智能——即能够模仿人类思维方式的机器——始终让科学家们无法实现。

rows.s: Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "Westworld" and "Humans".
rows.zh: 然而，人类仍然为这样的机器人设想所着迷：它们的外观、动作和反应都像人类，类似于近来在《西部世界》和《真实的人类》等热门科幻剧中所描绘的那些。

rows.s: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
rows.zh: 零售业行业团体称赞了这项裁决，称它为本地企业和网络企业创造了公平的竞争环境。

rows.s: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
rows.zh: 依据最高法院周四作出的一项裁决，各州将能够迫使更多的人在网上购物时缴纳销售税；这项裁决会让购物者的钱包更瘪，但对各州而言却是一大财政利好。

rows.s: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
rows.zh: 如今，竞争对手将在以前不曾征税的地方开始征收销售税。

rows.s: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
rows.zh: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内征收销售税，因为无论商品被运往哪个州，它们通常都在该州设有实体店。

rows.s: Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don't have to.
rows.zh: 亚马逊凭借其仓库网络，也在每一个征收销售税的州征税，尽管使用该网站的第三方卖家无须这样做。

rows.s: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
rows.zh: 迄今为止，许多仅在单个州或少数几个州设有实体存在的卖家，在向那些州以外的地址发货时，一直能够避免征收销售税。

rows.s: Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven't been collecting sales tax nationwide.
rows.zh: 使用 eBay 和 Etsy（这两个为规模较小的卖家提供平台的网站）的卖家，也一直没有在全国范围内征收销售税。

rows.s: Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state's sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
rows.zh: 根据周四的这项裁决，各州可以通过法律，要求州外卖家向顾客征收本州的销售税并将其上缴本州。

rows.s: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
rows.zh: 零售业分析师尼尔·桑德斯说，失利者是纯网络零售商，尤其是其中规模较小的那些。

rows.s: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
rows.zh: 那些零售商在遵守各州五花八门的销售税法时可能会面临种种麻烦。

rows.s: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision."
rows.zh: 小企业与创业委员会这一倡导团体在一份声明中表示：“这项裁决根本没有为小企业和互联网创业者带来任何好处。”

rows.s: The Supreme Court's opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.
rows.zh: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了两项有数十年历史的裁决，各州称这两项裁决每年令其损失数十亿美元的税收。

rows.s: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
rows.zh: 这些裁决使各州更难对某些网上购物征收销售税。

rows.s: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state.
rows.zh: 法院推翻的那些案件裁定：如果企业将顾客所购商品运往一个其没有实体存在（如仓库或办事处）的州，那么该企业就无须为该州征收销售税。

rows.s: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
rows.zh: 如果没有向顾客收取这笔税款，他们一般有责任自行向州政府缴纳销售税；但大多数人并未意识到自己欠税，而且很少有人真正缴纳。

rows.s: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
rows.zh: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪写道，先前的裁决存在缺陷。

rows.s: "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
rows.zh: 他在一份由另外四名大法官联署的意见书中写道：“实体存在规则每年都进一步脱离经济现实，并给各州造成大量的税收损失。”

rows.s: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
rows.zh: 肯尼迪写道，这一规则“限制了各州寻求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平的竞争环境中开展竞争”。

rows.s: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
rows.zh: 这项裁决对在许多州都设有业务的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常本来就已经对网上购物征收销售税了。

rows.s: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.
rows.zh: 同样，自动化最终应能提高生产率，通过压低价格刺激需求，并将工人从繁重无聊的工作中解放出来。

rows.s: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
rows.zh: 但从中期来看，中产阶级工人可能需要大量帮助来适应这一变化。

rows.s: The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training.
rows.zh: 正如埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲在《第二次机器革命》中所论述的，第一步应当是重新思考教育和职业培训。

rows.s: Curriculums—from grammar school to college—should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.
rows.zh: 课程设置——从小学到大学——应当不断演进，少强调死记硬背事实，多强调创造力和复杂的沟通能力。

rows.s: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem-solving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
rows.zh: 职业学校应当更好地培养学生解决问题的能力，并帮助学生学会与机器人协同工作。

rows.s: Online education can supplement the traditional kind.
rows.zh: 在线教育可以作为传统教育的补充。

rows.s: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
rows.zh: 它可以让额外的培训和指导变得人人负担得起。

rows.s: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
rows.zh: 想要掌握新技能的专业人士将能够做到这一点，而无需为此负债。

rows.s: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
rows.zh: 应对自动化的挑战凸显了美国重振其日渐衰退的商业活力的必要性：必须让创办新公司变得更容易。

rows.s: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
rows.zh: 在以往剧烈技术变革的时代，企业家们通过设想出各种结合劳动力与机器的办法，使这一转变变得平稳。

rows.s: Don't dismiss that possibility entirely.
rows.zh: 不要完全忽视那种可能性。

rows.s: The best uses of 3 D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet.
rows.zh: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳用途尚未被发明出来。

rows.s: The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them.
rows.zh: 美国需要这些将会发明这些用途的新公司。

rows.s: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
rows.zh: 最后，由于自动化有可能扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，税收和社会保障网将不得不重新加以审视。

rows.s: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
rows.zh: 低薪劳动的税收需要削减，工资补贴（如劳动所得税抵免）应当扩大：这将提高收入、鼓励就业、奖励创造就业岗位的企业，并减少不平等。

rows.s: Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation.
rows.zh: 在未来几年里，技术将以大大小小的方式改善社会，然而这对那些发现自己的生活和事业被自动化颠覆的人来说，几乎毫无安慰。

rows.s: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.
rows.zh: 摧毁那些正来抢我们饭碗的机器，将是愚蠢之举。

rows.s: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
rows.zh: 但帮助工人适应的各项政策将是不可或缺的。

rows.s: About half of U.S. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed.
rows.zh: 根据牛津大学的一项研究，大约一半的美国工作岗位面临着被自动化的高风险，其中中产阶级受到的挤压尤为严重。

rows.s: The rich own the robots, so they will be fine.
rows.zh: 富人拥有机器人，所以他们将安然无恙。

rows.s: This isn't to be alarmist.
rows.zh: 这并不是要危言耸听。

rows.s: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.
rows.zh: 乐观主义者指出，技术变革在过去曾使工人受益。

rows.s: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
rows.zh: 对于那些工作被机械织布机取代的卢德分子来说，工业革命进展得并不顺利，但它最终提高了生活水平，创造的工作岗位多于它所摧毁的。

rows.s: But many middle-class occupations—trucking, financial advice, software engineering—have aroused their interest, or soon will.
rows.zh: 但许多中产阶级职业——卡车运输、理财咨询、软件工程——已经引起了机器人的兴趣，或者很快就会。

rows.s: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don't appeal to robots.
rows.zh: 像园艺或日托这样的低收入工作对机器人没有吸引力。

rows.s: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?
rows.zh: 在中产阶级所面临的恼人挑战中，有一个挑战在下届总统竞选中很可能不会被提及：当机器人来抢他们的饭碗时，会发生什么？

rows.s: About a third say the problem of fake news lies in "misinterpretation or exaggeration of actual news" via social media.
rows.zh: 大约三分之一的人表示，假新闻问题在于通过社交媒体对真实新闻的“误读或夸大”。

rows.s: A new survey by Harvard University finds more than two-thirds of young Americans disapprove of President Trump's use of Twitter.
rows.zh: 哈佛大学的一项新调查发现，超过三分之二的美国年轻人不赞同特朗普总统使用推特。

rows.s: They cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives—especially those that are open about any bias.
rows.zh: 他们交叉核对信息来源，偏好来自不同视角的新闻——尤其是那些对自身任何偏见都坦诚相告的来源。

rows.s: "Many young people assume a great deal of personal responsibility for educating themselves and actively seeking out opposing viewpoints," the survey concluded.
rows.zh: 这项调查总结道：“许多年轻人承担起大量个人责任，去自我教育并主动寻求对立的观点。”

rows.s: Such active research can have another effect.
rows.zh: 这种主动的探究还可以产生另一种效果。

rows.s: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
rows.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国进行的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖带来了更高的政治参与度。

rows.s: Social media allows users to experience news events more intimately and immediately while also permitting them to re-share news as a projection of their values and interests.
rows.zh: 社交媒体让用户能够更亲近、更即时地体验新闻事件，同时也使他们能够重新分享新闻，将其作为自身价值观和兴趣的一种投射。

rows.s: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
rows.zh: 这迫使用户更加意识到自己在传递信息过程中所扮演的角色。

rows.s: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
rows.zh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人为假新闻现象给出的首要原因是“读者失误”，其程度甚于编造的故事或报道中的事实性错误。

rows.s: In other words, the choice to share news on social media may be the heart of the issue.
rows.zh: 换句话说，在社交媒体上分享新闻的这一选择，或许才是问题的核心所在。

rows.s: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
rows.zh: 巴纳集团主编罗克珊·斯通说：“这表明，在应对这一问题上，确实存在着切实的个人责任。”

rows.s: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president's social media platform.
rows.zh: 这意味着，千禧一代更希望来自白宫的消息是经由其他渠道过滤后传来的，而不是通过总统的社交媒体平台。

rows.s: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills—and in their choices on when to share on social media.
rows.zh: 因此，当年轻人批评一位过度发推的总统时，他们展现出一种心智上的自律——既体现在思维技能上，也体现在何时于社交媒体上分享的选择上。

rows.s: Most Americans rely on social media to check daily headlines.
rows.zh: 大多数美国人依靠社交媒体来查看每日的新闻头条。

rows.s: Such a trend is badly needed.
rows.zh: 这样一种趋势是非常必要的。

rows.s: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
rows.zh: 据牛津大学称，在2016年总统竞选期间，由政治上至关重要的密歇根州的推特用户所分享的网络内容中，近四分之一是假新闻。

rows.s: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
rows.zh: 一项为BuzzFeed新闻所做的调查发现，44%的脸书用户很少或从不信任来自这家媒体巨头的新闻。

rows.s: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
rows.zh: 作为数字原住民的年轻人，确实在网络空间辨别真伪方面变得越来越在行。

rows.s: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use "distributed trust" to verify stories.
rows.zh: 奈特基金会对14至24岁年轻人进行的焦点小组调查发现，他们使用“分布式信任”来核实报道。

rows.s: Yet as distrust has risen toward all media, people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills.
rows.zh: 然而，随着人们对所有媒体的不信任日益上升，他们或许正开始运用自己的媒体素养能力。

rows.s: That misses the way the surveillance economy works.
rows.zh: 但那种观念忽略了监控经济运作的方式。

rows.s: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain's National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.
rows.zh: 对英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）与 DeepMind 之间这笔交易的危险所作的任何公正评估，都必须从承认双方都是出于善意这一点开始。

rows.s: The data of an individual there gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.
rows.zh: 在那里，个人的数据只有在与其他无数百万人的数据进行比对时，才获得其价值。

rows.s: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
rows.zh: 在这种情况下，运用隐私法来遏制科技巨头显得有点不太对路。

rows.s: This practice does not address the real worry.
rows.zh: 这种做法并未触及真正令人担忧的问题。

rows.s: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.
rows.zh: 仅仅说 DeepMind 开发的算法将造福患者、挽救生命，这是不够的。

rows.s: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
rows.zh: 真正重要的是，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发出它们的私人垄断企业。

rows.s: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
rows.zh: DeepMind 是世界上领先的人工智能（AI）公司之一。

rows.s: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.
rows.zh: 如果软件承诺能以药物如今所能达到的规模来挽救生命，那么人们就可以预期大数据会像大型制药公司过去那样行事。

rows.s: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
rows.zh: 我们仍处于这场革命的开端，而如今微小的选择日后可能会被证明产生巨大的后果。

rows.s: A long struggle will be needed to avoid a future of digital feudalism.
rows.zh: 要避免一个数字封建主义的未来，将需要一场长期的斗争。

rows.s: Ms Denham's report is a welcome start.
rows.zh: 德纳姆女士的这份报告是一个值得欢迎的开端。

rows.s: Further arrangements—and there may be many—between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
rows.zh: 今后 NHS 与 DeepMind 之间的进一步安排（而且可能会有很多）都将受到仔细审查，以确保已向患者征得所有必要的许可，并且所有不必要的数据均已被清除。

rows.s: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
rows.zh: 这项工作应用于医疗保健的潜力非常巨大，但它也可能导致权力进一步集中于科技巨头手中。

rows.s: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free Hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
rows.zh: 正是在那样的背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆才对 NHS 下属的皇家自由医院信托发布了她的严厉裁定——该信托于 2015 年依据一份含糊的协议将 160 万名患者的记录移交给了 DeepMind，而那份协议远远没有充分顾及患者的权利及其对隐私的期待。

rows.s: DeepMind has almost apologized.
rows.zh: DeepMind 几乎已经道歉了。

rows.s: The NHS trust has mended its ways.
rows.zh: 这家 NHS 信托已经改正了自己的做法。

rows.s: There are lessons about informed patient consent to learn.
rows.zh: 在患者知情同意方面，还有一些教训需要吸取。

rows.s: But privacy is not the only angle in this case and not even the most important.
rows.zh: 但隐私并不是本案中唯一的角度，甚至也不是最重要的角度。

rows.s: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it "controlled" the data and DeepMind merely "processed" it.
rows.zh: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于这家 NHS 信托，因为按照现行法律，是它“控制”着这些数据，而 DeepMind 只是“处理”了这些数据。

rows.s: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
rows.zh: 但这种区分忽略了一个要点：正是对数据的处理和聚合、而非仅仅占有这些数据位，才赋予了数据价值。

rows.s: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
rows.zh: 最大的问题在于：谁应当从对我们的生活如今所产生的所有数据的分析中获益。

rows.s: Privacy law builds on the concept of damage to an individual from identifiable knowledge about them.
rows.zh: 隐私法建立在这样一个概念之上：由关于个人的可识别信息对该个人造成损害。

rows.s: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
rows.zh: 这就是近年来改革立法的多次尝试均告失败的原因，结果使邮政署除了推迟至关重要的现代化之外无力支付账单。

rows.s: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
rows.zh: 这笔钱的大部分将来自每封信永久加价一美分的资费上调，以及将邮政退休人员转入联邦医疗保险。

rows.s: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
rows.zh: 后一项措施将在很大程度上抵消每年为退休人员医疗保健预先筹资所带来的财务负担，从而解决邮政署及其工会长期以来的一项抱怨。

rows.s: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate—where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
rows.zh: 如果这项措施在众议院获得通过，它仍须通过参议院——在那里肯定会有人指出，它只相当于维持邮政署不致破产所需的最最低限度，而非全面改革。

rows.s: There's no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency's costs.
rows.zh: 对邮政署的集体谈判没有任何改变；考虑到人员开支占该机构成本的80%，这是一个重大遗漏。

rows.s: Also missing is any discussion of eliminating Saturday letter delivery.
rows.zh: 同样缺失的是关于取消周六信件投递的任何讨论。

rows.s: That common-sense change enjoys wide public support and would save the USPS $2 billion per year.
rows.zh: 这一合乎常理的改变享有广泛的公众支持，并且每年能为邮政署节省20亿美元。

rows.s: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.
rows.zh: 但邮政界的特殊利益集团似乎已经扼杀了这一改变，至少在众议院是如此。

rows.s: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.
rows.zh: 围绕该法案正在形成的共识表明，立法者们正对邮政署在政治上令人难堪的短期崩溃感到担忧。

rows.s: It is not, however, a sign that they're getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
rows.zh: 然而，它并不表明他们正在认真考虑为21世纪改造整个邮政系统。

rows.s: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.
rows.zh: 它报告2016财年净亏损56亿美元，这是其支出连续第10年超过收入。

rows.s: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
rows.zh: 与此同时，它还有超过1200亿美元的无资金保障债务，主要用于员工医疗和退休成本。

rows.s: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
rows.zh: 从根本上说，美国邮政局正处于一种历史性的挤压之中：一边是永久性地降低了对其主打产品（即一类邮件）需求的技术变革，另一边是使管理层无法灵活地根据新现实调整运营的监管结构。

rows.s: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self-interested pressure on the USPS's ultimate overseer—Congress—insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
rows.zh: 而从邮政工会到贺卡制造商等各种利益集团，都在对美国邮政署的最终监管者——国会——施加出于私利的压力，坚持要求无论邮政署还发生什么，他们所依赖的那些现状都必须得到保护。

rows.s: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.
rows.zh: 美国邮政署（USPS）持续亏损。

rows.s: Now comes word that everyone involved—Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users—has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
rows.zh: 如今传来消息：所有相关方——民主党、共和党、邮政署、工会以及该系统最大的用户——终于就一项修复该系统的方案达成了一致。

rows.s: Legislation is moving through the House that would save USPS an estimated $28.6 billion over five years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.
rows.zh: 一项立法正在众议院推进，它将在五年内为邮政署节省约286亿美元，这笔钱连同其他生存措施可帮助支付新车辆等开支。

rows.s: There are many reasons this formerly stable federal institution finds itself at the brink of bankruptcy.
rows.zh: 这个曾经稳定的联邦机构如今发现自己濒临破产，原因有很多。

rows.s: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become—but the lines are obvious.
rows.zh: 航空安检的效果究竟提高了多少目前还不清楚——但排起长队这一点是显而易见的。

rows.s: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International.
rows.zh: 自那以后加强的安检措施，再加上由于经济好转和油价低廉而带来的航空出行量增长，已导致芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等各大机场出现了漫长的等待。

rows.s: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons—both fake and real—past airport security nearly every time they tried.
rows.zh: 去年，运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现，卧底调查人员几乎每次尝试都能将武器（无论是假的还是真的）偷偷带过机场安检。

rows.s: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
rows.zh: 它也确实应当如此：被浪费的时间拖累了美国人的经济生活和私人生活，更不用说还令人恼火。

rows.s: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
rows.zh: 但是，对航空旅客要求过多，或者作为回报却只提供很少的安全保障，都会削弱公众对这一安检程序的支持。

rows.s: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA. Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
rows.zh: 预检计划本应是旅客和运输安全管理局双赢的局面。通过背景审查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

rows.s: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
rows.zh: 埃及航空804航班的失事——恐怖分子可能是在地中海上空将其击落的——再次令人痛心地提醒人们其中的缘由。

rows.s: First two hours, now three hours—this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
rows.zh: 起初是提前两小时，现在则是三小时——这就是当局建议人们要提前多久到达机场以赶上国内航班的情况，至少在一些安检队伍越来越长的美国主要机场是如此。

rows.s: It is long past time to make the program work.
rows.zh: 早就该让这个计划真正发挥作用了。

rows.s: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
rows.zh: 运输安全管理局不能继续把资源转移到利用率不足的预检通道上，而与此同时大多数出行公众却在不必要的排队中饱受煎熬。

rows.s: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
rows.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序，以换取安全性的提升。

rows.s: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
rows.zh: 但国会应当研究如何直接这么做，即通过帮助资助预检计划的注册费用，或以其他方式削减成本。

rows.s: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.
rows.zh: 即将到来的改革或许能把价格降到一个更合理的水平。

rows.s: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw.
rows.zh: 从一开始，这一价格就一直是预检计划的致命缺陷。

rows.s: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
rows.zh: 它（实际人数）远远没有接近那个目标，一个重要原因是价格令人咋舌：乘客每五年必须支付85美元来办理背景审查。

rows.s: The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.
rows.zh: 运输安全管理局希望让2500万人加入预检计划。

rows.s: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.
rows.zh: 这使得运输安全管理局能够把注意力集中在风险更高的旅客身上，从而为所有相关人员节省时间。

rows.s: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
rows.zh: 有一个步骤是运输安全管理局可以采取的，它既不需要改建机场，也不需要急于招人：那就是让更多的人加入预检（PreCheck）计划。

rows.s: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
rows.zh: 另一个因素可能是，越来越多的人为避免托运行李费而试图把随身行李塞得过满，尽管航空公司对此强烈否认。

rows.s: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.
rows.zh: 问题的一部分在于，机场可用于设置安检通道的空间就那么多（十分有限）。

rows.s: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
rows.zh: 问题的一部分在于，政府没有预料到航空出行量的急剧增长，因此运输安全管理局现在正急于让新的安检员上岗。

rows.s: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
rows.zh: 一小群直言不讳的夏威夷人和环保人士长期以来一直把这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的不敬，以及对曾是主权国家之地被占领的痛苦提醒。

rows.s: "The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897.
rows.zh: “古代夏威夷人是天文学家。”夏威夷最后一位在位的君主莉莉乌奥卡拉尼女王于1897年写道。

rows.s: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
rows.zh: 当前争议的部分责任应归咎于天文学家。

rows.s: In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world.
rows.zh: 在急于建造更大望远镜的过程中，他们忘记了科学并不是理解世界的唯一方式。

rows.s: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the islands' inhabitants.
rows.zh: 他们并不总是优先考虑保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统，也不总是顾及它对岛上居民的神圣意义。

rows.s: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.
rows.zh: 夏威夷文化并非过去的遗物；它是一种如今正在经历复兴的鲜活文化。

rows.s: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
rows.zh: 然而，科学同样有一段文化史，其根源可追溯到文明的曙光。

rows.s: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
rows.zh: 当初将早期波利尼西亚人带到夏威夷海岸、想要探明地平线之外世界的那同一份好奇心，如今正激励着天文学家去探索星空。

rows.s: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
rows.zh: 那些要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或禁止在那里进行未来开发的呼声，忽视了这样一个事实：天文学和夏威夷文化都试图回答关于我们是谁、来自何处、去向何方的重大问题。

rows.s: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
rows.zh: 也许这正是我们探索璀璨星空的原因，仿佛是在回应一种了解自己和我们真正祖先家园的原始召唤。

rows.s: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
rows.zh: 天文学界正在做出妥协，以改变其对莫纳克亚山的使用方式。

rows.s: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
rows.zh: 选择TMT的选址是为了尽量减少望远镜在岛屿周围的可见度，并避免对考古和环境造成影响。

rows.s: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.
rows.zh: 观星者是夏威夷社会中最受尊敬的成员之一。

rows.s: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.
rows.zh: 为了限制莫纳克亚山上望远镜的数量，旧的望远镜将在其使用寿命结束时被拆除，其场地也将恢复到自然状态。

rows.s: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
rows.zh: 没有任何理由不能欢迎每个人来到莫纳克亚山，去拥抱自己的文化遗产并研究星辰。

rows.s: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.
rows.zh: 遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学境况并不乐观。

rows.s: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
rows.zh: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造爆发了抗议，这座巨型天文台有望彻底改变人类的宇宙观。

rows.s: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
rows.zh: 争议焦点在于TMT计划建在莫纳克亚山上的位置——这座休眠火山被一些夏威夷人当作连接夏威夷群岛与天界的“皮科”（脐点）来崇拜。

rows.s: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
rows.zh: 但莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。

rows.s: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
rows.zh: 莫纳克亚山坐落于太平洋之中，其山峰耸立于地球稠密大气层的主体之上，在那里的条件使望远镜得以获取无与伦比的清晰图像。

rows.s: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
rows.zh: 对莫纳克亚山上建造望远镜的反对并不是什么新鲜事。

rows.s: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
rows.zh: 是的，自2008年全球崩盘以来出现了萌芽中的经济复苏，但在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上，主要经济体仍持续衰退。

rows.s: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
rows.zh: 为了对各国的表现做出更全面的评估，研究衡量的不仅仅是GDP，还有来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等领域的40多套不同标准。

rows.s: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."
rows.zh: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过，一个国家的GDP衡量的是"除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切"。

rows.s: Yet this isn't the case with all countries.
rows.zh: 然而，并非所有国家都是这种情况。

rows.s: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
rows.zh: 在被衡量的163个国家中，英国在确保经济增长转化为对其公民有意义的改善这方面，表现最差。

rows.s: It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.
rows.zh: 它衡量了那些无关紧要的事物，却遗漏了那些真正重要的事物。

rows.s: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.
rows.zh: 许多人认为它是一个有缺陷的概念。

rows.s: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
rows.zh: 关于GDP及其用处的问题，半个多世纪以来一直困扰着政策制定者。

rows.s: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
rows.zh: 随着英国投票脱离欧盟，并且GDP也因此被预测将放缓，现在正是评估他当时所指为何的恰当时机。

rows.s: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
rows.zh: 但是，那些将精力重新聚焦于改善福祉、而非仅仅担忧GDP数据的政策制定者，或许能够避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。

rows.s: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.
rows.zh: 全世界以及英国都预测到的对增长的猛烈打击，可能导致我们赖以维持幸福和增长的日常服务出现下滑。

rows.s: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
rows.zh: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家，在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的各项指标上，都取得了巨大的改善。

rows.s: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
rows.zh: 这是富裕国家可以汲取的一个教训：当GDP不再被视为衡量一个国家成功的唯一标准时，世界看起来就大不相同了。

rows.s: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
rows.zh: 因此，肯尼迪所指的是：尽管GDP一直是衡量各国经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不再足够。

rows.s: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes—all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.
rows.zh: 它不包括诸如环境质量或教育成果等重要因素——而所有这些都是有助于一个人幸福感的事物。

rows.s: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
rows.zh: 最近一项关于各国及其将经济增长转化为福祉的能力的年度研究，为那个问题提供了一些启示。

rows.s: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
rows.zh: 如果一切真的进展得如此顺利，那么为什么有超过1700万人不顾关于脱欧可能给本国经济前景带来何种影响的警告，仍投票支持脱欧呢？

rows.s: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
rows.zh: 按照最新的多数衡量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界羡慕的对象，失业率创历史新低，增长数据也很高。

rows.s: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.
rows.zh: 尽管所有这些国家都面临各自的挑战，但其中存在一些共同的主题。

rows.s: But it is not always corruption.
rows.zh: 但它并不总是腐败。

rows.s: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell.
rows.zh: 在一项罕见的全体一致的裁决中，美国最高法院推翻了对弗吉尼亚州前州长罗伯特·麦克唐纳的腐败定罪——其涉案行为包括接受一家寻求接触政府的公司所赠的礼物，例如一块劳力士手表和一辆法拉利汽车。

rows.s: "The basic compact underlying representative government," wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, "assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns."
rows.zh: 首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨代表法院写道：“作为代议制政府基础的基本契约设定，公职人员会听取选民的意见，并就其关切采取行动。”

rows.s: Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery.
rows.zh: 必须允许民选领导人帮助支持者解决官僚程序方面的问题，而不必担心因受贿而遭到起诉。

rows.s: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
rows.zh: 法院的这一裁决在界定一种不构成犯罪的偏袒行为方面，于法有据。

rows.s: Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an "official act."
rows.zh: 仅仅安排一次会面、打一个电话或举办一场活动，并不算“公职行为”。

rows.s: But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation.
rows.zh: 但根据反贿赂法，必须拿出具体利益的证据，比如对某项合同或法规的批准。

rows.s: The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is "distasteful" and "nasty."
rows.zh: 法院确实暗示，以为他人提供方便作为回报而收受好处是“令人反感的”且“恶劣的”。

rows.s: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
rows.zh: 大法官们认为，仅仅帮助送礼者接触其他官员并不构成腐败——除非这样做是出于向那些官员施压的明确意图。

rows.s: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
rows.zh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐纳案的审理法官未能告知陪审团：陪审团只应审视他的“公职行为”，即这位前州长就与其职责相关的“特定”且“未决”问题所作的决定。

rows.s: The court's ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism.
rows.zh: 法院的这一裁决，是在反对腐败和官员偏袒的斗争中向前迈出的一步。

rows.s: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
rows.zh: 良好的治理立足于对每个人固有价值的认识。

rows.s: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society—that all are equal in treatment by government—is undermined.
rows.zh: 如果人脉关系可以被收买，那么民主社会的一项基本前提——所有人受到政府的对待一律平等——就会遭到破坏。

rows.s: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy.
rows.zh: 相反，官员必须避免双重标准，即为普通人和富人提供不同类型的接触机会。

rows.s: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
rows.zh: 在获取官方接触机会方面的偏袒，会助长公众对腐败的观感。

rows.s: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
rows.zh: 但这一裁决强化了这样一种需要：应由公民及其选出的代表（而非法院）来确保人人都能平等地接触政府。

rows.s: Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift.
rows.zh: 决不能仅仅因为某个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或私人礼物，就允许官员在提供信息或安排会面时厚此薄彼。

rows.s: This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth.
rows.zh: 这种廉正需要在政府透明度方面有得到切实执行的法律，例如官方会议记录、游说规则，以及有关每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。

rows.s: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.
rows.zh: 这些措施有几个令人振奋的动机。

rows.s: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
rows.zh: 议会还同意封禁那些通过宣扬极端节食来"煽动过度消瘦"的网站。

rows.s: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
rows.zh: 更好的做法或许是，帮助将美的观念提升到超越某个特定行业物质标准的高度。

rows.s: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
rows.zh: 以全球时尚创新者自居的法国，已经认定其时尚业失去了为女性界定外表美的绝对权利。

rows.s: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
rows.zh: 也许还隐约地，它们暗示人们应当注重品格和才智之类的无形品质，而不是靠节食把自己变成零号身材或蜂腰体形。

rows.s: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep—and bone-showing.
rows.zh: 然而，法国的这些措施过于依赖严厉的惩罚来改变一种仍将美视为肤浅外表、乃至骨瘦如柴的文化。

rows.s: Under the law, using a fashion model that does not meet a government-defined index of body mass could result in a $85, 000 fine and six months in prison.
rows.zh: 根据该法律，使用不符合政府规定的身体质量指数的时装模特，可能会导致8.5万美元的罚款和六个月的监禁。

rows.s: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
rows.zh: 时尚业知道，自己在专注于物质装饰和理想化身材方面存在一个固有的问题。

rows.s: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
rows.zh: 这些禁令如果得到充分执行，就会向女性（以及许多男性）暗示：她们不应让他人成为评判自己美貌的人。

rows.s: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
rows.zh: 在丹麦、美国及其他几个国家，时尚业正试图为模特和时尚形象制定更多依靠同行压力来执行的自愿标准。

rows.s: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
rows.zh: 它们表明，美不应由那种最终损害健康的外貌来界定。

rows.s: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
rows.zh: 与法国的做法形成对比，丹麦的时尚业上个月就有关模特年龄、健康及其他特征的规则和制裁措施达成了一致。

rows.s: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people."
rows.zh: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确指出："我们意识到时尚业对身材理想观念（尤其是对年轻人）所产生的影响，并愿意为此承担责任。"

rows.s: The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
rows.zh: 该宪章主要的执行手段，是拒绝设计师和模特经纪公司进入由丹麦时尚学院运营的哥本哈根时装周（CFW）。

rows.s: But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
rows.zh: 但总体而言，它依靠一种"点名羞辱"的方法来促使各方遵守。

rows.s: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
rows.zh: 依靠道德劝说而非法律来解决对身材理想观念的滥用，也许是最好的举措。

rows.s: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
rows.zh: 上周，该国的立法者初步批准了一项法律，该法律将把在T台上雇用超瘦模特定为犯罪行为。

rows.s: It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape–measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
rows.zh: 它告诉时尚业：对于自己向女性（尤其是少女）传递的、关于她们必须用来衡量自身价值的社会标尺的信号，时尚业必须承担责任。

rows.s: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death—as some have done.
rows.zh: 而且，对超瘦模特的禁令似乎不仅仅是为了防止模特把自己饿死（确有模特如此），其意义更深远。

rows.s: That's a start.
rows.zh: 这是一个开端。

rows.s: Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow.
rows.zh: 乡村城镇和村庄一直在发展，将来也会持续发展。

rows.s: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorizing "off–plan" building where local people might object.
rows.zh: 保守党的规划改革明确赋予乡村开发优先于保护的地位，甚至批准在当地人可能反对的地方进行“计划外”建设。

rows.s: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.
rows.zh: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为“有利可图”。

rows.s: Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.
rows.zh: 工党同样希望在地方议会反对开发的地方终止地方规划。

rows.s: The Liberal Democrats are silent.
rows.zh: 自由民主党则保持沉默。

rows.s: Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land.
rows.zh: 只有英国独立党察觉到自己的机会，与那些呼吁更审慎地使用绿地的人站在了一起。

rows.s: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
rows.zh: 它的“保护英格兰乡村运动”令许多地方保守党组织闻之色变。

rows.s: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.
rows.zh: 建造新住宅、工厂和办公楼的明智之地，就在人们所在之处——在那些基础设施已经齐备的城市与城镇。

rows.s: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
rows.zh: 适用于伦敦的情况，在外省更是如此。

rows.s: In Britain this has had a curious result.
rows.zh: 在英国，这产生了一个奇怪的结果。

rows.s: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk.
rows.zh: 认为“住房危机”就等同于“被混凝土覆盖的草地”，这种观点纯粹是游说集团的论调。

rows.s: The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them.
rows.zh: 问题不在于是否需要更多住房，而一如既往地在于把它们建在哪里。

rows.s: Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.
rows.zh: 在游说压力之下，乔治·奥斯本偏向乡村新建，而非城市的翻修与更新。

rows.s: He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets.
rows.zh: 他偏向城外购物点，而非市中心的繁华商业街。

rows.s: This is not a free market but a biased one.
rows.zh: 这不是一个自由市场，而是一个有偏向的市场。

rows.s: They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character.
rows.zh: 当建设紧贴城镇边缘并尊重其特色时，它们的发展最为理想。

rows.s: We do not ruin urban conservation areas.
rows.zh: 我们不会破坏城市的保护区。

rows.s: Why ruin rural ones?
rows.zh: 那又为什么要破坏乡村的保护区呢？

rows.s: Development should be planned, not let rip, After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe's most crowded country.
rows.zh: 开发应当有规划，而不应放任自流。继荷兰之后，英国是欧洲人口最稠密的国家。

rows.s: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
rows.zh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村整体性，同时又仍允许低密度的城市生活。

rows.s: There is no doubt of the alternative—the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland.
rows.zh: 另一种结果是毫无疑问的——那就是葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰那种被破坏的景观。

rows.s: Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.
rows.zh: 避免这种局面而非助长它，本应使政治光谱的左右两派团结起来。

rows.s: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever".
rows.zh: 一个世纪以前，奥克塔维娅·希尔创立国民信托组织，并非为了拯救漂亮的房屋，而是为了永远为每个人保护“自然之地的美”。

rows.s: They don't make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it.
rows.zh: 乡村不会再被制造出来了，而每年混凝土都在吞噬更多的乡村。

rows.s: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country.
rows.zh: 在历史上第一次，居住在城镇的人比居住在乡村的人多。

rows.s: The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt.
rows.zh: 伦敦地产代理斯特林·阿克罗伊德最近发现，仅在伦敦地区就有足够建造五十万套住宅的用地，且无需侵占任何绿化带。

rows.s: It needs constant guardianship.
rows.zh: 它需要持续不断的守护。

rows.s: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.
rows.zh: 在下次选举中，似乎没有哪个大党愿意支持这种情感。

rows.s: It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience "a refreshing air".
rows.zh: 它的目的特别在于为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们在那里能够体验“清新的空气”。

rows.s: Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
rows.zh: 希尔的推动后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。

rows.s: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
rows.zh: 尽管民调显示，英国人把“乡村”与王室、莎士比亚以及国民医疗服务体系（NHS）一并视为最让他们为自己国家感到骄傲的东西，但这份情感在政治上得到的支持却很有限。

rows.s: "There is one and only one social responsibility of business,"
rows.zh: “企业有且只有一种社会责任，”

rows.s: Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firm's political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.
rows.zh: 他们的分析排除了这样一种可能性：即真正导致宽大处理的是公司的政治影响力、而非其CSR立场——那些对政治竞选捐款更多的公司并未获得更低的罚款。

rows.s: Second, customers may be willing to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps.
rows.zh: 其次，顾客可能愿意购买某公司的产品，以此作为向该公司所支持的公益事业捐款的一种间接方式。

rows.s: But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.
rows.zh: 但即便你接受弗里德曼的前提，并把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为对股东金钱的浪费，事情也未必绝对一目了然。

rows.s: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.
rows.zh: 总之，该研究得出结论：尽管检察官本应只依据案件本身的是非曲直来评判案件，但他们似乎确实会受到公司CSR记录的影响。

rows.s: "We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.
rows.zh: 一位研究者说：“我们估计，无论是消除某项重大劳工权益问题（如使用童工），还是把企业捐赠增加约20%，所带来的罚款通常都比贿赂外国官员的典型处罚低40%。”

rows.s: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
rows.zh: 研究者们承认，他们的研究并未回答企业究竟应该在CSR上花费多少这一问题。

rows.s: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
rows.zh: 该研究发现，在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面CSR项目的公司往往会受到较轻的处罚。

rows.s: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three.
rows.zh: 以往关于CSR的研究难以区分这些效应，因为消费者可能同时受到这三者的影响。

rows.s: And third, through a more diffuse "halo effect" whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
rows.zh: 第三，是通过一种更为弥散的“光环效应”，借此公司的善举为其赢得消费者及他人的更多体谅。

rows.s: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect.
rows.zh: 该研究认为，既然检察官在调查过程中不会消费公司的产品，那么他们就只可能受到光环效应的影响。

rows.s: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a "signal" that a company's products are of high quality.
rows.zh: 首先，消费者可能把CSR支出视为某公司产品高品质的一种“信号”。

rows.s: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.
rows.zh: 这可以通过三种方式为它们的业务增加价值。

rows.s: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.
rows.zh: 据咨询公司EPG的一项估计，美国和英国最大的公司每年共在CSR上花费超过150亿美元。

rows.s: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies—at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.
rows.zh: 新研究表明，CSR可能为公司创造货币价值——至少在它们因腐败而被起诉时如此。

rows.s: Wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel Prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits."
rows.zh: 诺贝尔奖得主经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼写道，“那就是，运用其资源、从事旨在增加其利润的活动。”

rows.s: But at least they have demonstrated that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment.
rows.zh: 但他们至少已经证明：当公司触犯法律陷入麻烦时，良好品行的证据能为它们赢得较轻的处罚。

rows.s: Nor does it reveal how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies.
rows.zh: 它也没有揭示，公司在决定其行善政策时，究竟在多大程度上指望的是光环效应、而非其他可能的好处。

rows.s: A recent study attempts to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under American's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).
rows.zh: 近期一项研究试图通过考察依据美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）提起的贿赂诉讼，来把这些效应区分开。

rows.s: Peretti gives the example of Netflix discontinuing its DVD–mailing service to focus on streaming.
rows.zh: 佩雷蒂举了网飞为专注于流媒体而停止其DVD邮寄服务的例子。

rows.s: Readers are migrating away from print anyway.
rows.zh: 无论如何，读者们正在不断地远离纸质版报纸。

rows.s: Peretti says the Times shouldn't waste time getting out of the print business, but only if they go about doing it the right way.
rows.zh: 佩雷蒂说，《纽约时报》不应在退出纸质业务上浪费时间，但前提是他们要以正确的方式去做。

rows.s: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.
rows.zh: 尽管纸质广告的销售额仍让其线上和移动端的同类相形见绌，但来自纸质版的收入仍在持续下降。

rows.s: Exactly when that day will be is a matter of debate.
rows.zh: 那一天究竟会在何时到来，是一个有争议的问题。

rows.s: "Then increase it at a higher rate each year and essentially try to generate additional revenue."
rows.zh: "然后每年以更高的幅度涨价，本质上就是设法创造额外的收入。"

rows.s: In other words, if you're going to make a print product, make it for the people who are already obsessed with it.
rows.zh: 换句话说，如果你打算做一款纸质产品，那就为那些已经痴迷于它的人去做。

rows.s: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.
rows.zh: 终将有一天，《纽约时报》会不再用新闻纸印刷报道。

rows.s: "Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition would make sense for them," he said, "but if you discontinue it, you're going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you."
rows.zh: 他说："想出一个办法来加速那种转变，对他们是有意义的，但如果你直接停掉它，你就会让你最忠实的顾客对你非常不满。"

rows.s: Sometimes that's worth making a change anyway.
rows.zh: 有时候，无论如何那也值得去做出改变。

rows.s: The move turned out to be foresighted.
rows.zh: 事实证明，这一举措是颇有远见的。

rows.s: And if Peretti were in charge at the Times?
rows.zh: 那么，假如佩雷蒂在《纽约时报》掌管大局，他会怎么做呢？

rows.s: "I wouldn't pick a year to end print," he said.
rows.zh: "我不会挑定某一年来终结纸质版，"他说。

rows.s: "I would raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product."
rows.zh: "我会提高价格，并把它变成更具传承意味的产品。"

rows.s: The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in.
rows.zh: 按这种设想，最忠实的顾客仍能得到他们喜爱的产品，而且他们会觉得自己是在帮助维系自己所信赖之物的品质。

rows.s: "It was seen as a blunder," he said.
rows.zh: "它当时被看作是一个失误，"他说。

rows.s: "So if you're overpaying for print, you could feel like you were helping," Peretti said.
rows.zh: "所以，如果你为纸质版多付了钱，你会感觉自己是在帮忙出力，"佩雷蒂说。

rows.s: "It's a really hard thing to do and it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business," Peretti remarked.
rows.zh: "这是一件很难做的事，而BuzzFeed没有需要背负的传统遗留业务，这是一种巨大的幸运，"佩雷蒂评论道。

rows.s: Which may be what the Times is doing already.
rows.zh: 而这或许正是《纽约时报》已经在做的事情。

rows.s: Getting the print edition seven days a week costs nearly $500 a year—more than twice as much as a digital–only subscription.
rows.zh: 一周七天都订阅纸质版，每年要花将近500美元——是纯数字版订阅费的两倍多。

rows.s: "But we're going to have questions like that where we have things we're doing that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes.
rows.zh: "但我们将会遇到诸如此类的问题：我们做着一些事情，而当市场和世界发生变化时，这些事情就变得不合理了。"

rows.s: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake, says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti.
rows.zh: BuzzFeed首席执行官乔纳·佩雷蒂说，管理费用可能很高、发行量可能更低，但匆忙取消其纸质版将会是一个错误。

rows.s: In those situations, it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive."
rows.zh: "在那些情况下，更具进取心要好过畏缩保守。"

rows.s: "Sometime in the future," the paper's publisher said back in 2010.
rows.zh: "未来的某个时候，"该报出版人早在2010年就这样说过。

rows.s: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there's plenty of incentive to ditch print.
rows.zh: 撇开对纸上油墨和翻页沙沙声的怀念不谈，放弃纸质印刷有着大量充足的理由。

rows.s: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper—printing presses, delivery trucks—isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.
rows.zh: 制作一份实体报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、运货卡车——不仅昂贵，而且在纯线上竞争对手并不受同样一套财务约束的当下，它更显得过度奢侈。

rows.s: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.
rows.zh: 西班牙的案例既为支持君主制、也为反对君主制提供了论据。

rows.s: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
rows.zh: 但与海湾地区和亚洲那些实行专制的同行不同，大多数王室之所以得以存续，是因为它们使选民得以免去寻找一位既无争议又受尊敬的公众人物这一难题。

rows.s: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch-infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).
rows.zh: 因此，除中东外，欧洲是世界上君主制最为盛行的地区，拥有10个王国（梵蒂冈城和安道尔尚未计入）。

rows.s: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted "kings don't abdicate, they die in their sleep."
rows.zh: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称："国王不会退位，他们只会在睡梦中死去。"

rows.s: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.
rows.zh: 即便如此，国王和王后们无疑也有其不利的一面。

rows.s: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history—and sometimes the way they behave today—embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
rows.zh: 尽管他们自称是民族团结的象征，但他们漫长的历史——有时还有他们今日的行事方式——所体现的却是过时且无从辩护的特权与不平等。

rows.s: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
rows.zh: 在托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家纷纷警告不平等日益加剧、继承财富的力量不断增强之际，富有的贵族家庭竟然仍是现代民主国家象征性的核心，这实在令人匪夷所思。

rows.s: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
rows.zh: 最成功的君主国都竭力摒弃或掩盖自身陈旧的贵族做派。

rows.s: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).
rows.zh: 王子和公主们都有日常工作，骑的是自行车，而非骏马（或直升机）。

rows.s: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
rows.zh: 即便如此，这些都是与国际富豪1%阶层一同纵情享乐的富裕家庭，而媒体的无孔不入又使得维持得体形象变得愈发困难。

rows.s: While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.
rows.zh: 尽管欧洲各君主国无疑足够精明，足以在未来一段时间内存续下去，但真正最该从西班牙的先例中感到忧惧的，却是英国王室。

rows.s: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
rows.zh: 唯有女王凭借她那相当寻常（尽管颇为富足）的祖母式作风，才维护住了君主制的声誉。

rows.s: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
rows.zh: 当公众舆论严重两极分化时——正如佛朗哥政权结束后所出现的那样——君主便能够超越"单纯的"政治，"体现"出民族团结的精神。

rows.s: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service—as non-controversial and non-political heads of state.
rows.zh: 他未能理解：君主制之所以大体上得以延续，是因为它们提供了一种服务——充当无争议、非政治化的国家元首。

rows.s: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
rows.zh: 但令人难堪的丑闻以及共和派左翼在近期欧洲议会选举中的高人气，迫使他收回前言、退位让贤。

rows.s: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
rows.zh: 正是这种对政治的明显超越，才解释了为何君主作为国家元首能够持续受到民众的拥护。

rows.s: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.
rows.zh: 查尔斯应当明白，正如英国历史所表明的那样，君主制最大的敌人正是国王本身，而非共和派。

rows.s: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.
rows.zh: 危险将随查尔斯而来，他既有奢华的生活品味，又持有一种相当等级森严的世界观。

rows.s: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
rows.zh: 那么，西班牙的危机是否表明君主制正走向末路？

rows.s: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
rows.zh: 那是否意味着，对所有身着华丽制服、过着威严生活的欧洲王室成员来说，末日已经临近？

rows.s: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California's advice.
rows.zh: 如果法院听从加利福尼亚州的建议，那将是一种草率的谦逊。

rows.s: Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data?
rows.zh: 宪法究竟在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？

rows.s: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
rows.zh: 一部智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通信的全面记录。

rows.s: The development of "cloud computing," meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.
rows.zh: 与此同时，"云计算"的发展使得这种探索变得容易了许多。

rows.s: Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy.
rows.zh: 美国人应当采取措施来保护自己的数字隐私。

rows.s: But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.
rows.zh: 但把敏感信息保存在这些设备上日益成为正常生活的一项必需。

rows.s: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution's prohibition on unreasonable searches.
rows.zh: 公民仍有权期待私人文件保持私密，并受宪法关于禁止不合理搜查之规定的保护。

rows.s: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
rows.zh: 正如常常出现的情况那样，陈述那条原则并不能减轻划定界限的难题。

rows.s: In many cases, it would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents.
rows.zh: 在许多情况下，当局要获得一张搜查令以查看手机内容并不会过于繁重。

rows.s: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
rows.zh: 在面临严峻、紧急的情况时，他们仍可使第四修正案的保护失效；他们也可以采取合理措施，确保手机数据在等待搜查令期间不被删除或篡改。
