rows.s: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
rows.zh: 不过，法院或许想要给警方留出空间，让其能够援引那些他们有权享有更多自由的情形。

rows.s: But the justices should not swallow California's argument whole.
rows.zh: 但大法官们不应全盘接受加利福尼亚州的论点。

rows.s: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
rows.zh: 最高法院现将审议：如果手机在逮捕时位于某人身上或身边，警方是否可以在没有搜查令的情况下搜查手机内容。

rows.s: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution's protections.
rows.zh: 新的、颠覆性的技术有时要求对宪法的保护作出新的运用。

rows.s: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
rows.zh: 法学教授奥林·克尔把21世纪数字信息的爆炸式增长与可获取性，比作20世纪将汽车使用确立为一种实际生活必需：当年大法官们必须为乘用车这一新的私人领域制定新规则；如今他们则必须厘清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息。

rows.s: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
rows.zh: 加利福尼亚州已请求大法官们不要做出宽泛的裁决，尤其是不要做出会颠覆旧有假定（即当局可以在逮捕嫌疑人时搜查其财物）的裁决。

rows.s: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
rows.zh: 该州辩称，法官们要评估新兴且快速变化的技术所带来的影响是很困难的。

rows.s: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
rows.zh: 足够多的影响是可以看出的，甚至是显而易见的，因此大法官们能够而且应该向警方、律师和被告提供更新的指导原则。

rows.s: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone—a vast storehouse of digital information—is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
rows.zh: 他们应当首先摒弃加利福尼亚州那个站不住脚的论点：即查看智能手机——一个庞大的数字信息仓库——的内容，就类似于比如说翻查嫌疑人的钱包。

rows.s: The court has ruled that police don't violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
rows.zh: 法院已裁定：警方在无搜查令的情况下翻查被捕者的钱包或皮夹时，并未违反第四修正案。

rows.s: But exploring one's smartphone is more like entering his or her home.
rows.zh: 但查看某人的智能手机更像是进入他或她的家。

rows.s: He agreed to join because he "found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact.
rows.zh: 他同意加入，因为他“发现设立 SBoRE 背后的远见卓识新颖、独特，并可能产生持久的影响”。

rows.s: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
rows.zh: 稿件将由该期刊的内部编辑、或其现有的评审编辑委员会、或外部同行评审人进行额外审查。

rows.s: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
rows.zh: 据细胞生物学家戴维·沃克斯说，专业科学家本应懂得如何分析数据，但统计错误在已发表的研究中却普遍得令人担忧。

rows.s: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
rows.zh: 主编玛西娅·麦克纳特今天宣布，《科学》杂志正在其同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计审查。

rows.s: This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science."
rows.zh: 这种影响不仅将通过《科学》杂志本身发表的论文产生，而且有望通过更多可能想要效仿《科学》做法的发表机构产生。

rows.s: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue."
rows.zh: 研究科研方法论的医生约翰·约安尼迪斯说，这项政策是“一个最受欢迎的进步”，而且“早就该实行了”。

rows.s: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.
rows.zh: “大多数期刊在统计审查方面都很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。”

rows.s: I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says.
rows.zh: 他说：“我认为，对于如今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家评审更为重要。”

rows.s: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
rows.zh: 但他指出，像《内科学年鉴》《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》这样的生物医学期刊高度重视统计审查。

rows.s: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process."
rows.zh: 他在 2012 年写道，研究人员应当提高自身标准，但期刊也应采取更严格的立场，“聘用具备统计学素养的审稿人，以及能够核查这一过程的编辑”。

rows.s: Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place".
rows.zh: 沃克斯说，《科学》把部分论文交给统计学家的想法“有一定优点，但弱点在于它一开始就要依赖评审编辑委员会去识别‘需要审查的论文’”。

rows.s: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
rows.zh: 在人们普遍担忧数据分析中的基本错误正导致许多已发表的研究结果无法重现之后，这项政策效仿了其他期刊的类似做法。

rows.s: "Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial.
rows.zh: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：“读者必须对我们期刊上发表的结论有信心。”

rows.s: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
rows.zh: 在与美国统计协会合作的过程中，该期刊任命了七位专家进入一个统计评审编辑委员会（SBoRE）。

rows.s: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
rows.zh: 随后，SBoRE 小组将寻找外部统计学家来审查这些稿件。

rows.s: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."
rows.zh: 在被问及是否有某些特定论文促成了这一变化时，麦克纳特说：“设立‘统计委员会’是出于对统计学和数据分析在科学研究中应用的广泛关切，同时也是《科学》整体推动提高我们所发表研究之可重复性的努力的一部分。”

rows.s: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to "play primarily an advisory role."
rows.zh: 哈佛公共卫生学院的生物统计学家、SBoRE 小组成员乔瓦尼·帕米贾尼说，他预计该委员会将“主要发挥咨询作用”。

rows.s: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
rows.zh: 被贬到边缘的那些词则是：公正、公平、宽容、相称与问责。

rows.s: Others await trial.
rows.zh: 其他人正等待受审。

rows.s: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.
rows.zh: 正如格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的那样，这是工业规模的窃听——穆尔凯尔正是2001年被《世界新闻报》雇来负责电话窃听的关键人物。

rows.s: As the hacking trial concludes—finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge—the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.
rows.zh: 随着窃听案审判落下帷幕——判定《世界新闻报》前主编安迪·库尔森因密谋窃听电话有罪，同时判定其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯在同一指控上无罪——诚信缺失这一更广泛的问题依然存在。

rows.s: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
rows.zh: 她认为，同样的这种道德目标的缺失正在伤害诸如新闻国际这样的公司，使其更有可能像在大规模非法电话窃听中那样误入歧途。

rows.s: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom."
rows.zh: 为了把观点讲透，她接着说道："越来越明显的是，目标的缺失，即政府、媒体或商界中道德语言的缺失，可能成为资本主义和自由所面临的最危险的目标之一。"

rows.s: But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit".
rows.zh: 但是"是我们，是人类，是我们这些人民创造了我们想要的社会，而不是利润"。

rows.s: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions—nor received traceable, recorded answers.
rows.zh: 布鲁克斯女士对手下记者如何得到报道也许有过怀疑，也许没有，但她没问任何问题，没下任何指示，也没收到任何可追溯、有记录的答复。

rows.s: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
rows.zh: 其目的乃是在追逐发行量和影响力的过程中毁掉他人的生活。

rows.s: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
rows.zh: 她说，诚信之所以崩塌，是因为人们集体地认同：社会中唯一的"分类机制"应当是利润和市场。

rows.s: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.
rows.zh: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的并不是为了增进读者的理解、在报道内容上做到公正，或体现任何共同的人性。

rows.s: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business–friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
rows.zh: 一直至关重要的那些词是：效率、灵活性、股东价值、利于经营、财富创造、销售、影响力，以及（在报业中）发行量。

rows.s: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.
rows.zh: 整整一代人以来，集体奉行的信条一直是：社会的分类机制应当是利润。

rows.s: Perhaps we should not be so surprised.
rows.zh: 也许我们本不应如此惊讶。

rows.s: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
rows.zh: 她成功辩护的核心就在于她对一切一无所知。

rows.s: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.
rows.zh: 最令人吃惊的揭露之一是：丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对其编辑部里所发生的事知道得何其之少，她多么没有想到去过问，以及她从不询问这些报道是如何得来的这一事实。

rows.s: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
rows.zh: 在许多方面，道德目标的缺失不仅框定了如此大规模电话窃听这一事实，也框定了审判赖以进行的条件。

rows.s: This long story still unfolds.
rows.zh: 这个漫长的故事仍在继续上演。

rows.s: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions."
rows.zh: 两年前，鲁伯特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到了"我们如此众多的机构中令人不安的诚信缺失"。

rows.s: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5, 500 people.
rows.zh: 据悉，记者们窃听了多达5500人的电话。

rows.s: In today's world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run.
rows.zh: 在当今世界，高薪主管不必为其所掌管的机构中发生的事情负责，这已经成了一件稀松平常的事。

rows.s: There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker's allowance.
rows.zh: 现在，领取求职者津贴将有七天的等待期。

rows.s: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for "fundamental fairness"—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
rows.zh: 我们将会明白，促使他这么做的，是他对"根本公平"的热忱——保护纳税人、控制开支，并确保只有最应得救济的申领者才能领到他们的救济金。

rows.s: More apparent reasonableness followed.
rows.zh: 随后又出现了更多表面上的合理之处。

rows.s: What could be more reasonable?
rows.zh: 还有什么比这更合情合理呢？

rows.s: "Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on," he claimed.
rows.zh: 他声称："最初这几天应当用来找工作，而不是闲逛。"

rows.s: Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit—and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly.
rows.zh: 只有当失业者带着简历到就业中心、注册在线求职并开始找工作时，他们才有资格领取救济金——而且此后他们应当每周而非每两周报到一次。

rows.s: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited "allowance," conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
rows.zh: 相反，申领者领到的是一笔以积极找工作为条件、有时限的"津贴"；没有应得权利，也没有保险性质，每周仅71.70英镑，是欧盟最不慷慨的津贴之一。

rows.s: You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life.
rows.zh: 如今你不再被需要；你被排除在能为你的生活提供目标和秩序的工作环境之外。

rows.s: Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
rows.zh: 甚至"求职者津贴"这个说法本身，也是在把失业者重新定义为一个"求职者"——这种求职者对自己通过缴纳国民保险金而挣得的救济，并不享有根本性的权利。

rows.s: George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme.
rows.zh: 财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了"预先求职"计划。

rows.s: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens.
rows.zh: 英国福利的原则不再是：你可以为失业风险投保，并在灾难真的发生时领取无条件的款项。

rows.s: It is as though 20 years of ever-tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened.
rows.zh: 这情形就好像对求职与救济管理制度长达二十年、越来越严厉的改革从未发生过一样。

rows.s: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency—permanent dependency if you can get it—supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.
rows.zh: 但在奥斯本的世界里，你的第一反应却是陷入依赖——如果能得到的话，就是永久的依赖——而这种依赖由一个非常乐于纵容你撒谎的国家所支撑。

rows.s: Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.
rows.zh: 去问问任何一个新近失业的人想要什么，答案永远是：一份工作。

rows.s: Losing a job is hurting: you don't skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state.
rows.zh: 失业是痛苦的：你不会哼着歌、满心欢喜地蹦跳着去就业中心，为能靠慷慨的国家使收入翻番的前景而欣喜。

rows.s: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
rows.zh: 更糟的是，那笔用来养活自己和家人、支付账单的至关重要的收入消失了。

rows.s: "We're doing these things because we know they help people stay off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster." Help? Really?
rows.zh: "我们之所以做这些事，是因为我们知道它们能帮助人们摆脱对救济的依赖，并帮助那些领取救济的人更快地找到工作。"帮助？真的吗？

rows.s: In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency,"
rows.zh: 为了"让生活变得更好"并减少"对救济的依赖"……

rows.s: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with "reforms" to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
rows.zh: 乍一听，这就是那位关心社会、努力改善人们生活的财政大臣，他还对一个明显纵容的制度推行了"改革"——该制度对新失业者找工作的要求太少，反而纵容了懒惰。

rows.s: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get.
rows.zh: 它在经济上令人恐惧，在心理上令人难堪，而且你知道，援助微乎其微而且极难获得。

rows.s: But most law graduates never get a big-firm job.
rows.zh: 但大多数法学毕业生从未能找到大律师事务所的工作。

rows.s: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.
rows.zh: 相反，他们中的许多人沦为那种滥诉者，使侵权法律制度变成代价高昂的噩梦。

rows.s: There are many reasons for this.
rows.zh: 造成这种情况的原因有很多。

rows.s: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.
rows.zh: 其中一个原因是法律教育费用过高。

rows.s: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
rows.zh: 最优秀的律师赚得盆满钵满，从而吸引越来越多的学生涌入法学院。

rows.s: This leaves today's average law-school graduate with $100, 000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
rows.zh: 这使得如今普通的法学院毕业生除本科债务之外，还要再背上10万美元的债务。

rows.s: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession—with the possible exception of journalism.
rows.zh: 在世界各地，律师比任何其他职业的从业者都更招人厌恶——新闻业可能是个例外。

rows.s: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.
rows.zh: 在美国大多数州，成为律师只有一条路：先在某些不相关学科上取得四年本科学位，然后在美国律师协会认可的200所法学院之一攻读三年法律学位，再加上为律师资格考试进行的昂贵备考。

rows.s: Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.
rows.zh: 改革这一制度将对律师和他们的客户都有好处。

rows.s: Law-school debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.
rows.zh: 法学院债务意味着他们不得不拼命努力工作。

rows.s: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
rows.zh: 明智的改革主意早已存在多年，但管理这一行业的州级机构过于保守，以致迟迟不予实施。

rows.s: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
rows.zh: 一个主意是允许人们将法律作为本科专业来攻读。

rows.s: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
rows.zh: 另一个主意是让学生只读两年法学院就可以参加律师资格考试。

rows.s: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
rows.zh: 如果律师资格考试对于一名准律师来说确实是足够严格的检验，那么那些能够更早参加考试的人就应当被允许这样做。

rows.s: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.
rows.zh: 那些不需要额外培训的学生能够把他们如山的债务削减三分之一。

rows.s: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
rows.zh: 费用如此之高的另一个原因，是这一行业限制性的、行会式的所有权结构。

rows.s: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.
rows.zh: 除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得拥有律师事务所的任何股份。

rows.s: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
rows.zh: 但是，没有几个地方能比美国让客户有更多的抱怨理由。

rows.s: This keeps fees high and innovation slow.
rows.zh: 这使得收费居高不下、创新步履迟缓。

rows.s: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
rows.zh: 行业内部存在要求变革的压力，但监管者中反对变革的人坚称，把外来者挡在律师事务所之外，能使律师免受那种只顾赚钱而不顾职业道德地服务客户的压力。

rows.s: In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms' efficiency.
rows.zh: 事实上，允许非律师持有律师事务所的股份将会降低成本并改善对客户的服务，因为这能鼓励律所采用新技术，并雇用专业管理者来专注于提高律所的效率。

rows.s: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.
rows.zh: 毕竟，其他国家，比如澳大利亚和英国，已经开始放开它们的法律行业了。

rows.s: America should follow.
rows.zh: 美国应当效仿。

rows.s: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation.
rows.zh: 在经济危机前的十年间，美国在法律服务上的支出增长速度是通货膨胀的两倍。

rows.s: The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money.
rows.zh: 当然，诺贝尔奖本身是由一位非常富有的人设立的，他已经决定好要用自己的钱做什么。

rows.s: The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.
rows.zh: 科学家们说，这些新奖项是其幕后操办者进行自我宣传的一种手段。

rows.s: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
rows.zh: 正如俗话所说，金钱买不到格调，这些暴发户企业家也无法为他们的奖项买来诺贝尔奖那样的声望。

rows.s: The US $3–million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year's award in March.
rows.zh: 正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫今年三月份接受该奖项时所说的那样，这项300万美元的基础物理学奖确实是一个有趣的实验。

rows.s: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
rows.zh: 它们可能会扭曲以同行评审为主导的研究中那套以成就为基础的体系。

rows.s: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.
rows.zh: 它们可能会固化同行评审研究的现状。

rows.s: They do not fund peer-reviewed research.
rows.zh: 它们并不资助同行评审的研究。

rows.s: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
rows.zh: 它们使「孤独天才」的神话长盛不衰（延续了孤胆天才的迷思）。

rows.s: The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.
rows.zh: 颁奖者的目标似乎和针对它们的批评一样杂乱无章。

rows.s: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
rows.zh: 一些人想引起轰动，另一些人则想把人们吸引到科学中来，或者更好地奖励那些在研究领域成就了一番事业的人。

rows.s: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes—both new and old—are distributed.
rows.zh: 正如《自然》杂志此前所指出的那样，对于科学奖项（无论新旧）究竟如何分配，存在一些合理的担忧。

rows.s: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
rows.zh: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖，对生命科学所涵盖的内容持有一种缺乏代表性的看法。

rows.s: But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research—as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
rows.zh: 但是，诺贝尔基金会每个奖项最多三名获奖者、且每人都必须仍然在世的限制，早已被现代研究的协作性质所超越——在确认希格斯玻色子的发现时，必将围绕谁被忽视而爆发不可避免的争论，这一点将印证上述结论。

rows.s: And it is far from the only one of its type.
rows.zh: 而且它远非这一类奖项中唯一的一个。

rows.s: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
rows.zh: 是时间，而非初衷，赋予了它们合法性（正当性）。

rows.s: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.
rows.zh: 尽管一些科学家可能会对这些新奖项颇有微词，但有两点似乎是确定无疑的。

rows.s: First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.
rows.zh: 第一，如果有人愿意授予，大多数研究人员都会接受这样一个奖项。

rows.s: Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere, It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism—that is the culture of research, after all—but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.
rows.zh: 第二，金钱和关注流向科学而非流向别处，这无疑是一件好事；批评和质疑这种机制是合理的——毕竟这正是研究的文化——但这毕竟是颁奖者的钱，他们爱怎么花就怎么花。

rows.s: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
rows.zh: 怀着感激与得体的态度接受这样的馈赠，才是明智之举。

rows.s: As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years.
rows.zh: 正如《自然》杂志一篇新闻专题文章所讨论的那样，近年来一系列面向研究人员的丰厚奖项加入了诺贝尔奖的行列。

rows.s: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
rows.zh: 许多奖项，比如基础物理学奖，其资金来自互联网企业家电话号码般庞大（多位数）的银行账户。

rows.s: These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
rows.zh: 他们说，这些捐助者已在各自选择的领域取得成功，并且他们想用自己的财富来吸引人们关注那些在科学界取得成就的人。

rows.s: What's not to like?
rows.zh: 这有什么不值得喜欢的呢？

rows.s: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.
rows.zh: 据新闻专题中引述的少数几位科学家所言，（不值得喜欢的地方）还真不少。

rows.s: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
rows.zh: 委员会忽视了这样一个事实：几十年来，美国的学院和大学培养出的毕业生并不了解自由教育的内容与特征，因而被剥夺了它所带来的益处。

rows.s: The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education.
rows.zh: 美国艺术与科学院对自由教育表现出极大的热情。

rows.s: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
rows.zh: 然而，其报告很可能因掩盖了国会要求它阐明的那一挑战的深度与广度而阻碍改革。

rows.s: Regrettably, however, the report's failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.
rows.zh: 然而，遗憾的是，该报告未能触及自由教育所面临危机的真正本质，这一缺陷可能弊大于利。

rows.s: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education."
rows.zh: 2010年，国会中主要的民主党人和共和党人致信美国艺术与科学院，要求该院确认"联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育者、个人资助者及其他方面"可以采取哪些行动，以"维持国家在人文学科与社会科学的学术和教育方面的卓越水平"。

rows.s: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas—such as free markets and self-reliance —as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
rows.zh: 如今，教授们惯常把对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义的公共政策视为研究的恰当对象，与此同时，却把保守派或古典自由派的思想（如自由市场和自力更生）描绘成超出常规、有时甚至是正当的学术探究的范围之外。

rows.s: In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
rows.zh: 作为回应，美国科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。

rows.s: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
rows.zh: 委员会的51名成员中，既有顶尖大学的校长、学者、律师、法官和企业高管，也有来自外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻界的知名人士。

rows.s: The goals identified in the report are generally admirable.
rows.zh: 报告中确定的这些目标总体上值得称赞。

rows.s: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
rows.zh: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》肯定了人文学科和社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣与安全的重要性，这一点值得赞扬。

rows.s: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
rows.zh: 由于代议制政府以了解情况的公民群体为前提，报告支持完全的读写能力，强调研究历史和政治学（尤其是美国历史和美国政治），并鼓励使用新的数字技术。

rows.s: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
rows.zh: 为了鼓励创新与竞争，报告呼吁增加研究投入，编制能提高学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通能力的连贯课程，增加对教师的资助，并鼓励学者运用其学识来应对当今的重大挑战。

rows.s: The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.
rows.zh: 报告还提倡加强对外语和国际事务的研究，并扩大海外留学项目。

rows.s: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
rows.zh: 遗憾的是，尽管历时两年半才完成，《问题的核心》却从未触及问题的核心——即我们一流学院和大学中自由教育的不自由本质。

rows.s: Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing "progressive," or left-liberal propaganda.
rows.zh: 可悲的是，曾在校园中盛行的探究精神，已被把人文学科和社会科学当作宣传"进步主义"即左翼自由派宣传之工具的做法所取代。

rows.s: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
rows.zh: 在过去十来年里，技术的进步使得Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众市场品牌得以更快地对潮流做出反应、更精准地预判需求。

rows.s: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
rows.zh: 这种自上而下的时尚业观念再过时不过了，也与伊丽莎白·克莱恩对“快时尚”进行三年调查后在《过度着装》一书中所描述的那个狂热世界格格不入到了极点。

rows.s: Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant's sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.
rows.zh: 普里斯特利解释道，这位助理毛衣的那种深蓝色是如何多年来从时装秀一路流传到百货商店，再流传到那个可怜女孩无疑买下自己这件衣服的廉价货筐里的。

rows.s: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2, 300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
rows.zh: 要让H&M能在其全球2300多家门店里供应一条售价仅5.95美元的针织迷你裙，它就必须依赖低薪的海外劳工、大批量订货以致使自然资源紧张，并使用大量有害的化学品。

rows.s: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
rows.zh: 当然，这场革命的受害者并不仅限于设计师。

rows.s: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
rows.zh: 克莱恩认为，通过以极其低廉的价格提供紧跟潮流的商品，这些品牌劫持了时尚的周期，撼动了一个长期习惯于按季节节奏运转的行业。

rows.s: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable—meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that—and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
rows.zh: 这些品牌鼓励注重款式的消费者把衣服看作一次性用品——尽管它们并不明说，这种衣服其实只够洗上一两次——并且每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。

rows.s: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her.
rows.zh: 在2006年的电影版《穿普拉达的女魔头》中，由梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯特利训斥她那不起眼的助理，因为这位助理竟以为高级时尚与自己毫不相干。

rows.s: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
rows.zh: 虚荣心是恒定不变的；只有当人们再也承担不起不这么做的代价时，他们才会开始以更可持续的方式购物。

rows.s: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
rows.zh: 她展现出许多可持续发展倡导者所共有的那种理想主义，无论是在食品领域还是能源领域皆是如此。

rows.s: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment—including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line—Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
rows.zh: 尽管若干快时尚公司已努力减小它们对劳工和环境的影响——比如推出绿色“良知系列”的H&M——但克莱恩认为，持久的变革只能由消费者来推动。

rows.s: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.
rows.zh: 但正如克莱恩率先指出的那样，博蒙特花了数十年才把手艺练得炉火纯青；她这样的榜样是无法被轻易复制的。

rows.s: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
rows.zh: 《过度着装》是时尚界对诸如迈克尔·波伦的《杂食者的困境》之类消费者维权畅销书的回应。

rows.s: "Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful," Cline argues.
rows.zh: “批量生产的服装如同快餐一样，满足了人们的渴望和需求，却不耐用且造成浪费，”克莱恩这样论述道。

rows.s: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year—about 64 items per person—and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
rows.zh: 她发现，美国人每年大约购买200亿件衣服——人均约64件——而且无论他们捐出多少，这种过量购买都会造成浪费。

rows.s: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes—and beautifully.
rows.zh: 在《过度着装》一书接近尾声时，克莱恩介绍了她心目中的理想典范——一位名叫莎拉·凯特·博蒙特的布鲁克林女子，自2008年以来她一直自己缝制全部衣服，而且做得相当漂亮。

rows.s: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
rows.zh: 更快的周转意味着更少的库存浪费、更频繁的新品发布以及更多的利润。

rows.s: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
rows.zh: 由于无法判断某人是真的反对行为广告，还是只是沿用了微软的默认设置，有些公司可能会无视DNT信号，照旧推进。

rows.s: Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
rows.zh: 微软的IE浏览器和苹果的Safari浏览器都已提供DNT；谷歌的Chrome预计今年也会跟进。

rows.s: It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
rows.zh: 微软称，将随Windows 8一同推出的IE 10版本会把DNT设为默认选项。

rows.s: In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
rows.zh: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在互联网浏览器中增加一个"禁止追踪"（DNT）选项，以便用户能告知广告商自己不愿被追踪。

rows.s: Or should they have explicit permission?
rows.zh: 还是说，他们应当先取得明确的许可？

rows.s: Could it really be that simple?
rows.zh: 事情真会有那么简单吗？

rows.s: Brendon Lynch, Microsoft's chief privacy officer, blogged: "we believe consumers should have more control."
rows.zh: 微软首席隐私官布伦登·林奇在博客中写道："我们认为消费者应当拥有更多的控制权。"

rows.s: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: There is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
rows.zh: 如果它是想打击几乎完全依赖广告收入的谷歌，那它选的是一种迂回的办法：因为并不能保证默认开启DNT会成为行业惯例。

rows.s: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
rows.zh: 毕竟，微软自己也有广告业务；它声称这项业务会遵从DNT请求，尽管目前仍在研究具体该怎么做。

rows.s: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
rows.zh: 在互联网时代，至少从理论上讲，这一比例可以大幅降低。

rows.s: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
rows.zh: 同样不清楚的是，微软为何要单枪匹马地这样做。

rows.s: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
rows.zh: 收到DNT信号并不强制任何人停止追踪，尽管有些公司已经承诺会这样做。

rows.s: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
rows.zh: 广告商将如何回应，目前还不清楚。

rows.s: People will not get fewer ads, he says, "they'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads."
rows.zh: 他说，人们并不会得到更少的广告，“他们得到的将是意义更小、针对性更弱的广告”。

rows.s: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
rows.zh: 美国全国广告商协会的首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯说，如果广告业无法收集消费者的偏好信息，消费者的处境反而会更糟。

rows.s: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
rows.zh: 如今很少有人主动开启DNT，但如果追踪本就处于关闭状态，它就会一直保持关闭。

rows.s: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
rows.zh: 鉴于人性本就如此，大多数人都会沿用默认设置。

rows.s: Advertisers are horrified.
rows.zh: 广告商们大为惊恐。

rows.s: DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8—though the firm has compared some of its other products favourably with Google's on that count before.
rows.zh: 对Windows 8来说，DNT似乎算不上一个明显的巨大卖点——尽管该公司此前曾在这方面拿自己的其他产品与谷歌的产品作过有利于自身的比较。

rows.s: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioural" ads at those most likely to buy.
rows.zh: 通过观察人们在网上搜索、点击和谈论的内容，公司就能把"行为"广告精准投向那些最有可能购买的人。

rows.s: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
rows.zh: 在过去几周里，一场争论凸显了这类精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否应当假定人们乐于被追踪并被推送行为广告呢？

rows.s: In February the FTC and the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
rows.zh: 2月，FTC和数字广告联盟（DAA）达成一致：业界将着手处理DNT请求。

rows.s: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted—the trouble is, no one knows which half.
rows.zh: 一句老话说，所有广告预算中有一半都被浪费了——问题是，没人知道是哪一半。

rows.s: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row.
rows.zh: 5月31日，微软挑起了这场争端。

rows.s: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.
rows.zh: 科学技术将治愈人类所有的弊病，从而让所有人都能过上充实且充满机遇的生活。

rows.s: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.
rows.zh: 如今，越来越多的研究者和机构正在认真思考那个问题。

rows.s: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely—though by no means uniformly—glowingly positive.
rows.zh: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的设想在很大程度上——尽管绝非千篇一律——还是灿烂乐观的。

rows.s: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
rows.zh: 例如，“今与未来基金会”的旗舰项目是一座机械钟，其设计目标是在数千年之后仍能继续计时。

rows.s: So what does our deep future hold?
rows.zh: 那么，我们遥远的未来会是怎样的呢？

rows.s: Take a broader look at our species' place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
rows.zh: 更广阔地审视我们这一物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地看到：我们极有可能存续数万年，乃至数十万年。

rows.s: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years—so why shouldn't we?
rows.zh: 化石记录表明，许多物种已经存续了数百万年——那么我们为什么不能呢？

rows.s: But such gloominess is misplaced.
rows.zh: 但这种悲观情绪是没有道理的。

rows.s: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
rows.zh: 你甚至可能会忍不住认为，人类没有什么值得期待的未来。

rows.s: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.
rows.zh: 但如今我们已经掌握了足够的知识，足以减少许多曾威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后人的境遇。

rows.s: To be sure, the future is not all rosy.
rows.zh: 诚然，未来并非一片光明。

rows.s: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.
rows.zh: 这种长远视角使得对我们前景的悲观看法，更像是一阵转瞬即逝的风潮。

rows.s: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
rows.zh: 正如常常发生的那样，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：我们如今已辨识出足够多塑造这颗星球及我们这一物种历史的长期模式，足以对我们后代将身处的境况作出基于证据的预测。

rows.s: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
rows.zh: 但只要把眼光放长远，就会有数量惊人的内容是我们可以相当有把握地说出来的。

rows.s: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
rows.zh: 这正是我们创办Arc——一份专注于近期未来的新刊物——的原因之一。

rows.s: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
rows.zh: 当今技术的潜在演变及其社会后果令人眼花缭乱地复杂，也许最好留给科幻作家和未来学家去探索我们能设想的诸多可能性。

rows.s: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.
rows.zh: 或许是有意为之，思考这样漫长的时间尺度，可能比思考更近的未来更容易。

rows.s: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the international Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN), and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline."
rows.zh: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种“红色名录”中查阅智人，你会读到：“被列为‘无危’，因为该物种分布极广、适应力强、目前数量正在增长，且不存在导致整体种群数量下降的重大威胁。”

rows.s: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
rows.zh: 如今乌托邦已经过时了，因为我们更深刻地认识到了我们所面临的种种威胁——从小行星撞击到流感疫情，再到气候变化。

rows.s: That's because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
rows.zh: 这是因为国会一向设想由联邦和州联合执行移民法，并明确鼓励州一级官员共享信息、与联邦同行展开合作。

rows.s: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday—a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
rows.zh: 最高法院以五票对三票的表决结果，于周一推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这对奥巴马政府来说是一场不大不小的政策胜利。

rows.s: Two of the three objecting Justices—Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas—agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
rows.zh: 三位持异议的大法官中有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——认同这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州的哪些规定与联邦法规相冲突的问题上意见不一。

rows.s: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
rows.zh: 唯一一项重大异议来自大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚，他对那些可追溯至《外侨与煽动叛乱法》的州权提出了更为有力的辩护。

rows.s: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as "a shocking assertion of federal executive power".
rows.zh: 这场针对奥巴马总统、以8比0作出的反对，其关键在于大法官塞缪尔·阿利托在其异议中所称的“对联邦行政权力的一种骇人主张”。

rows.s: The White House argued that Arizona's laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
rows.zh: 白宫辩称，即便亚利桑那州的法律与联邦法规一字不差地相符，它们仍与白宫的执法重点相冲突。

rows.s: In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
rows.zh: 实际上，白宫宣称，它可以宣布任何它所不赞同的、原本合法的州法律无效。

rows.s: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
rows.zh: 某些权力确实专属于联邦政府，对公民身份和边境的控制权就在其中。

rows.s: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
rows.zh: 但是，如果国会想阻止各州动用自己的资源来核查移民身份，它本来是能够做到的。

rows.s: It never did so.
rows.zh: 它（国会）从未这样做过。

rows.s: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
rows.zh: （奥巴马）政府实质上是在主张：因为它自己不愿执行国会的移民意愿，所以任何州也都不应被允许这样做。

rows.s: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
rows.zh: 但是在更为重要的宪法问题上，这一裁决意味着政府意图打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的努力遭遇了8比0的彻底失败。

rows.s: Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.
rows.zh: 每一位大法官都理所当然地驳回了这一惊人的主张。

rows.s: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
rows.zh: “只有联邦政府才有权‘制定统一的归化规则’”以及“联邦法律优先于州法律”这两条宪法原则，都是没有争议的。

rows.s: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
rows.zh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定一套与现行联邦政策相平行的州政策。

rows.s: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.
rows.zh: 在首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨和法院自由派大法官的支持下，大法官安东尼·肯尼迪裁定，亚利桑那州飞得离联邦这个太阳太近了（即越了权）。

rows.s: On the overturned provisions the majority held Congress had deliberately "occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
rows.zh: 在那些被推翻的条款上，多数派认为，国会已经蓄意“占据了这一领域”，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦所享有的专属权力。

rows.s: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
rows.zh: 然而，大法官们表示，亚利桑那州警察将获准核查那些与执法部门有接触者的合法身份。

rows.s: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
rows.zh: 在「亚利桑那州诉美国政府」案中，多数派推翻了亚利桑那州那项争议计划里四条受质疑条款中的三条——该计划要让州和地方警察去执行联邦移民法。

rows.s: Rage Against the Haze failed once state funding was cut.
rows.zh: 州政府的资金一被削减，'怒驱烟霾'项目就失败了。

rows.s: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
rows.zh: 如本书所呈现的，社会疗法最明显的缺陷在于：它无法在很长时间内很好地发挥作用。

rows.s: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
rows.zh: 《加入俱乐部》充斥着过多无关的细节，却没有对令同辈压力如此强大的社会与生物因素进行足够的探讨。

rows.s: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive.
rows.zh: 但在社会疗法的总体效果方面，罗森伯格的论证就缺乏说服力了。

rows.s: Come on—Everybody's doing it.
rows.zh: 得了吧——每个人都在这么做。

rows.s: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
rows.zh: 罗森伯格令人信服地论证：公共卫生倡导者应当向那些如此善于施加同辈压力的广告商借鉴取经。

rows.s: "Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers—teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.
rows.zh: '敢于与众不同，请别吸烟！'——一则旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌宣传如此恳求，而这些青少年最渴望的莫过于融入群体。

rows.s: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.
rows.zh: 她对许多公共卫生运动之拙劣的批评一针见血：它们未能为养成健康习惯而调动同辈压力，而且暴露出对心理学的严重错误理解。

rows.s: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
rows.zh: 这个想法看起来很有前景，而且罗森伯格是一位敏锐的观察者。

rows.s: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
rows.zh: 在南非，一项名为'爱生活'的艾滋病预防行动招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。

rows.s: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
rows.zh: 罗森伯格作为普利策奖得主，提供了大量社会疗法实际运用的例证：在南卡罗来纳州，一个名为'怒驱烟霾'的州资助禁烟项目着手让香烟变得不再'酷'。

rows.s: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
rows.zh: 但在她的新书《加入俱乐部》中，蒂娜·罗森伯格主张：通过她所谓的'社会疗法'，同辈压力也可以成为一种积极的力量；在这种疗法中，各组织和官员利用群体动力的力量来帮助个人改善他们的生活，乃至改善整个世界。

rows.s: It usually leads to no good—drinking, drugs and casual sex.
rows.zh: 它通常不会带来什么好结果——酗酒、吸毒和随意的性行为。

rows.s: And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
rows.zh: 这正是从外部人为设计的社会疗法所存在的问题：在现实世界中，正如在学校里一样，我们坚持选择自己的朋友。

rows.s: The tactic never really works.
rows.zh: 这种策略从来都没有真正奏效过。

rows.s: It's like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates.
rows.zh: 这就像那位通过把后排捣蛋的学生与表现较好的同学配对来拆散他们的老师。

rows.s: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
rows.zh: 那句一半是邀请、一半是强迫的悄声话语，正是我们大多数人一听到'同辈压力'这个词时所想到的东西。

rows.s: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
rows.zh: 然而，专家和官僚能够多么成功地选择我们的同辈群体并将其活动引向良性方向，这一点则远不那么确定。

rows.s: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
rows.zh: 这是一种微妙的同伴压力：我们会不自觉地模仿自己每天所见到的行为。

rows.s: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits—as well as negative ones—spread through networks of friends via social communication.
rows.zh: 一系列新兴的研究表明，积极的健康习惯——以及消极的习惯——都会通过社会交往在朋友网络中传播。

rows.s: There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
rows.zh: 毫无疑问，我们的同辈群体对我们的行为施加着巨大的影响。

rows.s: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.
rows.zh: 关于'爱生活'项目能否带来持久改变的证据既有限又相互矛盾。

rows.s: But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company's application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.
rows.zh: 但当核管理委员会（NRC）审查该公司的申请时，它应当牢记恩特吉公司的承诺到底有几分价值。

rows.s: It's a stunning move.
rows.zh: 这是令人震惊的一招。

rows.s: The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont's only nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon.
rows.zh: 这场冲突自 2002 年起就一直在浮现，当年这家公司买下了佛蒙特州唯一的核电站——弗农镇一座老化的反应堆。

rows.s: As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.
rows.zh: 作为获得州政府批准这笔交易的条件，该公司同意向州监管机构申请在 2012 年之后继续运营的许可。

rows.s: Then, too, the company went along.
rows.zh: 当时，这家公司也照办了。

rows.s: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments, or it simply didn't foresee what would happen next.
rows.zh: 要么 Entergy 从未真正打算信守那些承诺，要么它根本没有预料到接下来会发生什么。

rows.s: In 2006, the state went a step further, requiring that any extension of the plant's license be subject to the Vermont legislature's approval.
rows.zh: 2006 年，州政府更进一步，要求该电站执照的任何延期都必须经过佛蒙特州议会的批准。

rows.s: A deal is a deal—except, apparently, when Entergy is involved.
rows.zh: 说话本应算数——但显然，一旦涉及 Entergy 公司，情况就另当别论了。

rows.s: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management—especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.
rows.zh: 一连串事故——包括 2007 年一座冷却塔的部分坍塌以及发现地下管道系统渗漏——引发了人们对佛蒙特北方核电站安全性和 Entergy 公司管理的严重质疑，尤其是在该公司就管道问题作出误导性陈述之后。

rows.s: Enraged by Entergy's behavior, the Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 last year against allowing an extension.
rows.zh: 被 Entergy 的行为激怒，佛蒙特州参议院去年以 26 票对 4 票投票反对批准延期。

rows.s: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.
rows.zh: 如今这家公司突然声称：由于 2006 年的立法，2002 年的协议无效；而且只有联邦政府才拥有对核问题的监管权。

rows.s: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
rows.zh: 该案中的法律问题晦涩难明：尽管最高法院已裁定各州对核电确实拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者们表示，佛蒙特案将提供一次开创先例的检验，以确定这些权力的边界究竟有多大。

rows.s: Certainly, there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.
rows.zh: 诚然，对于如果每个州都各自制定规则而可能出现的拼凑式监管，人们确有正当的担忧。

rows.s: But had Entergy kept its word, that debate would be beside the point.
rows.zh: 但倘若 Entergy 当初信守了诺言，那场争论本来根本无关紧要。

rows.s: The company seems to have concluded that its reputation in Vermont is already so damaged that it has nothing left to lose by going to war with the state.
rows.zh: 这家公司似乎已经断定，它在佛蒙特州的声誉已经严重受损，以至于与该州开战也不会再有什么损失。

rows.s: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
rows.zh: 这家公司是新英格兰地区一家主要的能源供应商，上周它宣布背弃长期以来遵守严格核管理规定的承诺，在佛蒙特州激起了人们正当的愤怒。

rows.s: But there should be consequences.
rows.zh: 但理应承担后果。

rows.s: Permission to run a nuclear plant is a public trust.
rows.zh: 经营核电站的许可是一种公共信托。

rows.s: Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in Plymouth.
rows.zh: Entergy 在美国还经营着另外 11 座反应堆，其中包括普利茅斯的朝圣者核电站。

rows.s: Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to keep it open for another 20 years.
rows.zh: 在承诺安全运营朝圣者核电站的同时，这家公司已申请联邦许可，以求让其再继续运营 20 年。

rows.s: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
rows.zh: 相反，这家公司所做的恰恰是它长期以来承诺不会做的事：在联邦法院挑战佛蒙特州规定的合宪性，以此作为拼命保住其佛蒙特北方核电站继续运转的努力的一部分。

rows.s: The goal is new-search, not re-search.
rows.zh: 目标是“新探”，而不是“重探（重复已有研究）”。

rows.s: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
rows.zh: 对已经被知晓和相信之事的重复与确认，几乎得不到什么回报。

rows.s: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
rows.zh: 第一，科学工作往往聚焦于主流知识中被视为不完整或不正确的某些方面。

rows.s: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
rows.zh: 在这一确立可信度的整个过程中，存在着两个悖论。

rows.s: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
rows.zh: 随着一项发现性主张在科学共同体中逐步推进，围绕所涉科学与技术的共享信念与相互竞争的信念之间的相互作用与碰撞，便将个人的发现性主张转变为共同体可信的发现。

rows.s: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
rows.zh: 在科学共同体复杂的社会结构内，研究者作出发现；编辑和审稿人通过控制发表过程充当把关人；其他科学家利用新发现来服务于自己的目的；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）接收新发现以及可能随之而来的技术。

rows.s: But, unlike with mining claims, the community takes control of what happens next.
rows.zh: 但是，与采矿权主张不同的是，科学共同体掌控着接下来所发生的一切。

rows.s: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
rows.zh: 一旦一项发现性主张公之于众，发现者便获得知识上的功劳。

rows.s: Objective knowledge is the goal, not the starting point.
rows.zh: 客观知识是目标，而不是起点。

rows.s: In the idealized version of how science is done, facts about the world are waiting to be observed and collected by objective researchers who use the scientific method to carry out their work.
rows.zh: 在科学如何展开的理想化版本中，关于世界的事实正等待着被客观的研究者们观察和收集，这些研究者运用科学方法来开展自己的工作。

rows.s: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
rows.zh: 但是，要把一项发现性主张转变为成熟的发现，需要集体的审查与认可。

rows.s: We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences.
rows.zh: 我们力求做到客观，但我们无法摆脱自身独特人生经历所形成的背景的影响。

rows.s: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
rows.zh: 先前的知识和兴趣影响着我们所体验到的东西、我们认为这些体验意味着什么，以及我们随后采取的行动。

rows.s: Consequently, discovery claims should be thought of as protoscience.
rows.zh: 因此，发现性主张应被视为原科学（尚未成熟的科学）。

rows.s: Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
rows.zh: 误读、错误和自欺的可能性比比皆是。

rows.s: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.
rows.zh: 这就是确立可信度的过程，通过这一过程，单个研究者的“我、此地、此刻”变成了科学共同体的“任何人、任何地点、任何时间”。

rows.s: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
rows.zh: 与新近圈定的采矿权主张相似，它们充满潜力。

rows.s: "We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason."
rows.zh: “我们一起推理，相互质疑、修正并完善彼此的推理，以及彼此对理性的理解。”

rows.s: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim—a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
rows.zh: 最终，可信度“降临”到一项发现性主张之上——这一过程对应于哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的“心智的公共领域”。

rows.s: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
rows.zh: 有时，真正新颖的发现性主张需要数年时间才能被接受和认可。

rows.s: But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.
rows.zh: 但是，想到其他人未曾想到的东西、并告诉别人他们错过了什么，却未必能改变他们的看法。

rows.s: Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Györgyi once described discovery as "seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought."
rows.zh: 诺贝尔奖得主、生理学家阿尔伯特·圣捷尔吉曾把发现描述为“看到人人都看到的东西，却想到无人想到的东西”。

rows.s: Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief.
rows.zh: 第二，新颖性本身常常引发怀疑。

rows.s: But in the everyday practice of science, discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route.
rows.zh: 但在科学的日常实践中，发现往往遵循一条模糊而复杂的路径。

rows.s: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
rows.zh: 不出所料，新发表的、看起来重要且令人信服的发现性主张和可信的发现，总是会面临未来研究者的质疑以及可能的修正或反驳。

rows.s: A quarter of America's public-sector workers have a university degree.
rows.zh: 四分之一的美国公共部门雇员拥有大学学位。

rows.s: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
rows.zh: 如果工会会员吉米·霍法今天还活着，他可能会代表公务员。

rows.s: Some of their ties go back a long way.
rows.zh: 他们的一些关系由来已久。

rows.s: Britain's Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.
rows.zh: 正如其名称所暗示的，英国工党长期以来一直与工会运动联系在一起。

rows.s: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public–sector unions.
rows.zh: 其现任领导人埃德·米利班德能登上这一职位，靠的是来自公共部门工会的选票。

rows.s: At the state level their influence can be even more fearsome.
rows.zh: 在州一级，他们的影响力甚至更加令人生畏。

rows.s: Mark Baldassare of the Public Policy Institute of California points out that much of the state's budget is patrolled by unions.
rows.zh: 加州公共政策研究所的马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州的大部分预算都受到工会的把控。

rows.s: The teachers' unions keep an eye on schools, the CCPOA on prisons and a variety of labor groups on health care.
rows.zh: 教师工会盯着学校，加州惩教和平警官协会盯着监狱，而形形色色的劳工团体则盯着医疗保健。

rows.s: In many rich countries average wages in the state sector are higher than in the private one.
rows.zh: 在许多富裕国家，国有部门的平均工资都高于私营部门。

rows.s: But the real gains come in benefits and work practices.
rows.zh: 但真正的好处体现在福利待遇和工作惯例方面。

rows.s: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
rows.zh: 政客们一再对公共部门薪酬协议进行后置加码处理：工资涨幅保持温和，却增加了本已优厚的假期，尤其是养老金。

rows.s: When Hoffa's Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.
rows.zh: 在1960年霍法的卡车司机工会鼎盛之时，只有十分之一的美国政府雇员加入工会；而如今这一比例达到了36%。

rows.s: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers' unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.
rows.zh: 尽管大量证据表明教师素质是最重要的变量，教师工会却一直反对淘汰差教师、提拔好教师。

rows.s: As the cost to everyone else has become clearer, politicians have begun to clamp down.
rows.zh: 随着其他所有人所付出的代价日益明显，政客们已开始着手严加管控。

rows.s: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.
rows.zh: 在威斯康星州，工会已经动员了成千上万的支持者来反对强硬的共和党州长斯科特·沃克。

rows.s: But many within the public sector suffer under the current system, too.
rows.zh: 但公共部门内部也有许多人在现行制度下深受其苦。

rows.s: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.
rows.zh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员体系中的文化规范适合那些安于现状的人，却不利于高成就者。

rows.s: The only American public-sector workers who earn well above $250, 000 a year are university sports coaches and the president of the United States.
rows.zh: 唯一年收入远超25万美元的美国公共部门雇员是大学体育教练和美国总统。

rows.s: Bankers' fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.
rows.zh: 银行家丰厚的薪酬已招致诸多批评，但一个不奖励高成就者的公共部门体系，对美国来说或许是个严重得多的问题。

rows.s: In 2009 the number of unionists in America's public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.
rows.zh: 2009年，美国公共部门的工会会员数量超过了私营部门的会员数量。

rows.s: In Britain, more than half of public-sector workers but only about 15% of private-sector ones are unionized.
rows.zh: 在英国，超过半数的公共部门雇员加入了工会，而私营部门雇员的入会率却只有约15%。

rows.s: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.
rows.zh: 首先，他们可以让事情停摆，而几乎不会承受什么后果。

rows.s: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.
rows.zh: 其次，他们大多聪明且受过良好教育。

rows.s: Third, they now dominate left–of–centre politics.
rows.zh: 第三，他们如今主导着中左翼政治。

rows.s: There are three reasons for the public-sector unions' thriving.
rows.zh: 公共部门工会之所以蓬勃发展，有三个原因。

rows.s: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
rows.zh: 改革遭到了强烈反对，或许其中最为人诟病的就是教育领域——在那里，特许学校、自治学校和绩效工资都经历了旷日持久的斗争。

rows.s: But what will be the nature of that difference?
rows.zh: 但是，那种差别的本质究竟会是什么呢？

rows.s: Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
rows.zh: 仅仅扩大乐团的演出曲目是远远不够的。

rows.s: If Gilbert and the Philharmonic are to succeed, they must first change the relationship between America's oldest orchestra and the new audience it hopes to attract.
rows.zh: 如果吉尔伯特和爱乐乐团想要取得成功，他们就必须首先改变美国这个最古老的乐团与它希望吸引的新观众之间的关系。

rows.s: For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least.
rows.zh: 在很大程度上，至少可以说，反响一直是积极的。

rows.s: One of the reasons why the appointment came as such a surprise, however, is that Gilbert is comparatively little known.
rows.zh: 然而，这一任命之所以如此令人意外，原因之一便是吉尔伯特相对而言鲜为人知。

rows.s: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him "an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him."
rows.zh: 就连曾在《纽约时报》上支持对吉尔伯特任命的托马西尼，也称他是'一位不爱张扬、身上毫无令人敬畏的指挥家派头的音乐家'。

rows.s: As a description of the next music director of an orchestra that has hitherto been led by musicians like Gustav Mahler and Pierre Boulez, that seems likely to have struck at least some Times readers as faint praise.
rows.zh: 作为对一个迄今一直由古斯塔夫·马勒和皮埃尔·布列兹这样的音乐家执掌的乐团的下一任音乐总监的描述，这番话似乎会让至少一些《纽约时报》读者觉得不过是不痛不痒的赞扬。

rows.s: For my part, I have no idea whether Gilbert is a great conductor or even a good one.
rows.zh: 就我而言，我不知道吉尔伯特是否是一位伟大的指挥家，甚至连他是否称得上是一位优秀的指挥家都不清楚。

rows.s: To be sure, he performs an impressive variety of interesting compositions, but it is not necessary for me to visit Avery Fisher Hall, or anywhere else, to hear interesting orchestral music.
rows.zh: 诚然，他演奏了种类繁多、令人印象深刻的有趣作品，但我并不需要专程去艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅或其他任何地方，才能听到有趣的管弦乐。

rows.s: All I have to do is to go to my CD shelf, or boot up my computer and download still more recorded music from iTunes.
rows.zh: 我所要做的，不过是走到我的CD架前，或者启动电脑，从iTunes上下载更多录制好的音乐罢了。

rows.s: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
rows.zh: 为了争夺热爱艺术的公众的时间、注意力和金钱，古典器乐演奏家不仅要与歌剧院、舞蹈团、剧团和博物馆竞争，还要与20世纪那些伟大古典音乐家的录制演出一较高下。

rows.s: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover, they can be "consumed" at a time and place of the listener's choosing.
rows.zh: 这些录音价格低廉、随处可得，而且在艺术质量上往往远高于当今的现场演出；此外，它们还可以在听众自己选定的时间和地点被'消费'。

rows.s: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
rows.zh: 因此，这类录音的广泛普及，给传统古典音乐会这一体制带来了一场危机。

rows.s: "Hooray! At last!" wrote Anthony Tommasini, a sober-sided classical-music critic.
rows.zh: '万岁！终于来了！'严肃认真的古典音乐评论家安东尼·托马西尼这样写道。

rows.s: One possible response is for classical performers to program attractive new music that is not yet available on record.
rows.zh: 一种可能的应对方法，是让古典演奏家编排那些尚未出过唱片、有吸引力的新音乐。

rows.s: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
rows.zh: 那些反驳说录音无法替代现场演出的忠实音乐会观众，其实没有抓住问题的要点。

rows.s: The decision of the New York Philharmonic to hire Alan Gilbert as its next music director has been the talk of the classical-music world ever since the sudden announcement of his appointment in 2009.
rows.zh: 自2009年突然宣布对阿兰·吉尔伯特的任命以来，纽约爱乐乐团聘请他担任下一任音乐总监这一决定，一直是古典音乐界的热门话题。

rows.s: Gilbert's own interest in new music has been widely noted: Alex Ross, a classical-music critic, has described him as a man who is capable of turning the Philharmonic into "a markedly different, more vibrant organization."
rows.zh: 吉尔伯特本人对新音乐的兴趣已被广泛注意到：古典音乐评论家阿历克斯·罗斯曾把他描述为一个能够把爱乐乐团变成'一个明显不同、更具活力的机构'的人。

rows.s: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
rows.zh: 多年来，高管和猎头一直恪守这样一条准则：最具吸引力的首席执行官人选，正是那些必须被（费力）挖来的人。

rows.s: Broadcasting his ambition was "very much my decision," McGee says.
rows.zh: 公开宣扬自己的抱负"完全是我自己的决定"，麦基说。

rows.s: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group, which named him CEO and chairman on September 29.
rows.zh: 两周之内，他便首次与哈特福德金融服务集团的董事会进行洽谈，该集团于9月29日任命他为首席执行官兼董事长。

rows.s: McGee says leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.
rows.zh: 麦基说，在没有落实新职位的情况下离职，给了他时间去思考自己想要经营什么样的公司。

rows.s: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
rows.zh: 这也向外界传递了一个关于他抱负的明确信息。

rows.s: And McGee isn't alone.
rows.zh: 而且麦基并非个例。

rows.s: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
rows.zh: 随着董事会迫于股东压力审查继任计划，那些未能获得青睐的高管也可能希望另谋出路。

rows.s: In recent weeks the No. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
rows.zh: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的二号高管相继辞职，他们解释说自己正在寻找首席执行官的职位。

rows.s: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
rows.zh: 当利亚姆·麦基于八月卸任美国银行总裁时，他给出的解释出奇地直白。

rows.s: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
rows.zh: 动荡的商业环境也使高级经理人变得谨慎，不愿让含糊其辞的表态损害自己的声誉。

rows.s: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
rows.zh: 随着经济复苏的最初迹象开始显现，副手们可能更愿意在没有任何保障的情况下放手一搏。

rows.s: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.
rows.zh: 据 Liberum Research 的数据，第三季度首席执行官的更替率比一年前下降了23%，原因是惶恐不安的董事会留用了现有的领导者。

rows.s: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
rows.zh: 随着经济好转，对有抱负的领导者来说，机会将会大量涌现。

rows.s: The decision to quit a senior position to look for a better one is unconventional.
rows.zh: 辞去高级职位去寻找一份更好工作的决定是不同寻常的。

rows.s: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: "I can't think of a single search I've done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first."
rows.zh: 光辉国际资深合伙人丹尼斯·凯里说："我想不起自己做过的任何一次猎聘中，董事会没有指示我先去考察在任的首席执行官。"

rows.s: Those who jumped without a job haven't always landed in top positions quickly.
rows.zh: 那些没有找好新工作就贸然跳槽的人，并不总能很快地谋得高位。

rows.s: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago, saying she wanted to be a CEO.
rows.zh: 十年前，艾伦·马拉姆辞去了纯果乐负责人的职务，称自己想成为一名首席执行官。

rows.s: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.
rows.zh: 过了一年，她才当上一家小型互联网商品交易所的负责人。

rows.s: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company."
rows.zh: 他没有像往常那样用含糊的借口来掩饰离职，而是直截了当地说，他要离开是"为了追求经营一家公司的目标"。

rows.s: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.
rows.zh: 罗伯特·威卢姆斯塔德于2005年怀着成为首席执行官的抱负离开了花旗集团。

rows.s: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later.
rows.zh: 三年之后，他终于在一家大型金融机构坐上了那个职位。

rows.s: Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.
rows.zh: 许多招聘者表示，对于业绩出众者来说，这种旧有的耻辱感正在淡化。

rows.s: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one.
rows.zh: 金融危机使得处于待业状态或辞去一份糟糕的工作变得更容易被人接受了。

rows.s: "The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted," says one headhunter.
rows.zh: 一位猎头说："传统准则认为待在原地更安全，但如今这一观念已被彻底颠覆。"

rows.s: "The people who've been hurt the worst are those who've stayed too long."
rows.zh: "那些受伤害最深的人，正是那些在原职位上待得太久的人。"

rows.s: In such a case, the company's response may not be sufficiently quick or thoughtful, and the learning curve has been steep.
rows.zh: 在这种情况下，公司的反应可能不够迅速或不够周全，而这一学习过程一直颇为艰难。

rows.s: This trend, which we believe is still in its infancy, effectively began with retailers and travel providers such as airlines and hotels and will no doubt go further.
rows.zh: 这一趋势——我们认为它仍处于起步阶段——实际上始于零售商以及航空公司、酒店之类的旅游服务商，并且无疑还将进一步发展。

rows.s: We define such sold media as owned media whose traffic is so strong that other organizations place their content or e-commerce engines within that environment.
rows.zh: 我们把这种售出媒体定义为这样一种自有媒体：其流量极大，以至于其他机构会把自己的内容或电商引擎放置于该环境之中。

rows.s: But in some cases, one marketer's owned media become another marketer's paid media—for instance, when an e-commerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.
rows.zh: 但在某些情况下，一个营销者的自有媒体会成为另一个营销者的付费媒体——例如，当一家电商零售商在其网站上出售广告位时。

rows.s: For earned media, such marketers act as the initiator for users' responses.
rows.zh: 而对于赢得媒体而言，这类营销者则充当用户回应的发起者。

rows.s: Paid and owned media are controlled by marketers promoting their own products.
rows.zh: 付费媒体和自有媒体由推销自家产品的营销者所控制。

rows.s: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
rows.zh: 如今消费者作出购买决定的方式意味着，营销的影响力来自传统付费媒体之外的广泛因素。

rows.s: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
rows.zh: 对某种产品充满热情的消费者，可以通过自愿向朋友推荐它来创造"赢得"媒体；而公司则可以通过向注册了其网站的顾客发送有关产品和促销的电子邮件提醒，来利用"自有"媒体。

rows.s: While traditional "paid" media—such as television commercials and print advertisements—still play a major role, companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media.
rows.zh: 尽管传统的"付费"媒体（如电视广告和平面广告）仍然扮演着重要角色，但如今的公司可以利用许多替代性的媒体形式。

rows.s: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.
rows.zh: 例如，丰田汽车公司凭借一场相对迅速且精心策划的社交媒体应对行动，减轻了今年早些时候召回危机所造成的部分损害；这场行动包括直接在Twitter以及社交新闻网站Digg等平台上与消费者互动的种种努力。

rows.s: If that happens, passionate consumers would try to persuade others to boycott products, putting the reputation of the target company at risk.
rows.zh: 如果那种情况发生，热情的消费者就会试图劝说他人抵制相关产品，从而使目标公司的声誉陷入险境。

rows.s: Members of social networks, for instance, are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
rows.zh: 例如，社交网络的成员们正在意识到，他们可以劫持媒体，以此向最初创建这些媒体的企业施加压力。

rows.s: Such hijacked media are the opposite of earned media: an asset or campaign becomes hostage to consumers, other stakeholders, or activists who make negative allegations about a brand or product.
rows.zh: 这类被劫持的媒体与赢得性媒体恰恰相反：一项资产或一场营销活动沦为消费者、其他利益相关者或激进分子的人质，这些人会对某个品牌或产品发表负面指控。

rows.s: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
rows.zh: 同样这些为营销者提供了更多（且更多样）传播选择的剧烈技术变革，也增加了这样一种风险：热情的消费者会以更快速、更显眼且更具破坏性的方式表达自己的意见。

rows.s: Besides generating income, the presence of other marketers makes the site seem objective, gives companies opportunities to learn valuable information about the appeal of other companies' marketing, and may help expand user traffic for all companies concerned.
rows.zh: 除了创造收入之外，其他营销者的存在还能让该网站显得客观，给公司带来机会去了解其他公司营销吸引力的宝贵信息，并且可能有助于扩大所有相关公司的用户流量。

rows.s: Johnson & Johnson, for example, has created BabyCenter, a stand-alone media property that promotes complementary and even competitive products.
rows.zh: 例如，强生公司创建了BabyCenter，这是一个推广互补产品乃至竞争产品的独立媒体资产。

rows.s: The rough guide to marketing success used to be that you got what you paid for. No longer.
rows.zh: 过去那条粗略的营销成功法则是：一分钱一分货（你付出多少就得到多少）。如今不再如此。

rows.s: It doesn't seem quite fair, then, to compare the regrets of parents to the regrets of the childless.
rows.zh: 那么，把为人父母者的悔恨与无子女者的悔恨相比较，这似乎不太公平。

rows.s: It's hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut.
rows.zh: 很难想象会有很多人蠢到仅仅因为Reese和Angelina把生孩子弄得看起来如此光鲜就想要孩子：大多数成年人都明白，养个孩子可不是换个发型那么简单。

rows.s: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that "the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight."
rows.zh: 尽管日复一日养育孩子的体验可能艰辛得令人心力交瘁，Senior却写道：那些在当下让我们情绪低落的事情，日后却可能成为强烈满足感与喜悦的源泉。

rows.s: The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week.
rows.zh: 这期展示着一位漂亮母亲抱着可爱婴儿的杂志封面，绝非本周报刊亭上唯一的圣母圣婴形象。

rows.s: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?
rows.zh: 在一个如此执着地推崇生育的社会里，承认你后悔生孩子无异于承认你支持虐杀小猫，这又有什么奇怪的呢？

rows.s: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
rows.zh: 几乎每一周都会刊登至少一位在报刊亭上微笑的名人妈妈或准妈妈。

rows.s: There are also stories about newly adoptive—and newly single—mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual "Jennifer Aniston is pregnant" news.
rows.zh: 此外还有关于新近收养孩子且新近单身的母亲Sandra Bullock的报道，以及那条惯常的"Jennifer Aniston怀孕了"的新闻。

rows.s: But it's interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren't in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting "the Rachel" might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
rows.zh: 但有意思的是，我们不妨思考一下：我们每周所看到的那些无忧无虑、提升幸福感的为人父母形象，是否正以某种微小而潜意识的方式加剧着我们对真实育儿体验的不满——就如同我们内心深处曾有一小部分希望剪个"Rachel发型"能让自己看上去稍稍有点像Jennifer Aniston一样。

rows.s: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
rows.zh: 不幸福的父母很少会被促使去思考自己是不是不该要孩子，但不幸福的无子女者却被这样一种信息所困扰：孩子是世上唯一最重要的事物——显然，他们的痛苦必定是其生活中那个婴儿大小的巨大空洞造成的直接结果。

rows.s: Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.
rows.zh: Senior没有断言孩子会让父母或快乐或痛苦，而是认为我们需要重新定义幸福：我们不应把幸福看作某种可以用时时刻刻的快乐来衡量的东西，而应把幸福视为一种过去时态的状态。

rows.s: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, "I Love My Children, I Hate My Life," is arousing much chatter—nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.
rows.zh: Jennifer Senior那篇见解深刻、引人争议的杂志封面故事《我爱我的孩子，我恨我的生活》正在引发大量议论，这不足为奇——没有什么比暗示养育子女远非一种完全令人满足、丰富人生的体验更能让人们议论纷纷了。

rows.s: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
rows.zh: 当然，《Us Weekly》和《People》这类名人杂志所呈现的为人父母的形象极不真实，尤其是当那些父母是像Bullock那样的单身母亲时。

rows.s: According to several studies concluding that parents are less happy than childless couples, single parents are the least happy of all.
rows.zh: 根据若干项得出"父母不如无子女夫妇幸福"这一结论的研究，单身父母是所有人中最不幸福的。

rows.s: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their "own" (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.
rows.zh: 这并不令人意外，毕竟没有可依靠的伴侣而独自养孩子要付出多少辛劳；然而听Sandra和Britney的说法，靠自己（意即：有全天候的帮手）养孩子简直是小菜一碟。

rows.s: Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
rows.zh: 然而如今他只有一本书还在印行，而他大量的音乐论著除了专家之外几乎无人知晓。

rows.s: He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored.
rows.zh: 他于1967年被封为爵士，是第一位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。

rows.s: Neville Cardus, who wrote for the Manchester Guardian from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket.
rows.zh: 内维尔·卡迪斯从1917年起直到1975年去世前不久一直为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿，但如今他仅仅以一位写板球随笔的作家而为人所知。

rows.s: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
rows.zh: 在过去二十五年间英语报纸所发生的所有变化中，影响最深远的也许就是其艺术报道在范围和严肃性上不可阻挡的衰退。

rows.s: Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are'."
rows.zh: 纽曼写道，“以至于我禁不住想把‘新闻业’定义为‘一个被无人问津的作家用来蔑称那些拥有读者的作家的词’。”

rows.s: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten.
rows.zh: 不幸的是，这些评论家几乎都被遗忘了。

rows.s: During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music critics and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a best-seller.
rows.zh: 不过，在他生前，他还是英国最重要的古典音乐评论家之一，是一位备受推崇的文体家，以至于他的《自传》（1947年）成了畅销书。

rows.s: "So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism,"
rows.zh: “能有足够的才智或足够的文学天赋来在新闻业中站稳脚跟的作者实在太少了，

rows.s: These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
rows.zh: 这些人把新闻业视为一种神圣的职业来信奉，并以能在日报上发表作品为荣。

rows.s: Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about.
rows.zh: 他们的工作是一项严肃的事业，即便是那些把学问看得很轻、不事张扬的评论家，比如萧伯纳和欧内斯特·纽曼，也可以让人信赖他们是懂行的。

rows.s: In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
rows.zh: 在那遥远的年代，大报的评论家会对他们所报道的事件进行详尽而长篇的评论，这被认为是理所当然的事。

rows.s: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
rows.zh: 我们与那些散漫的报纸评论相隔得更远了——它们发表于20世纪初到二战前夕之间的英国，在那个年代，新闻纸极其廉价，而有格调的艺术评论被视为它所刊登的出版物的一种点缀。

rows.s: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
rows.zh: 今天读这样的书，会让人惊叹于这样一个事实：它们那些博学的内容竟曾被认为适合发表在面向大众发行的日报上。

rows.s: Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
rows.zh: 然而，20世纪出版的最重要的评论集中，相当一部分大部分都是由报纸评论构成的。

rows.s: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers.
rows.zh: 对于一个四十岁以下的普通读者来说，要想象一个能在大多数大城市报纸上读到高质量艺术评论的年代，其难度几乎到了不可能的地步。

rows.s: Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
rows.zh: 此外，音乐评论中的业余传统一直在急速地退却。

rows.s: Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
rows.zh: 不过，早在他去世之前很久，新闻品味就已经改变了，而后现代读者对他所擅长的那种辞藻华丽、繁复堆砌的维多利亚-爱德华时代散文几乎毫无兴趣。

rows.s: The prospect seems remote.
rows.zh: 这种前景似乎很渺茫。

rows.s: Is there any chance that Cardus's criticism will enjoy a revival?
rows.zh: 卡迪斯的评论有没有可能迎来复兴呢？

rows.s: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
rows.zh: 那项裁决引发了商业方法专利申请的激增，最初是由那些试图为特定类型在线交易圈定独家权利的新兴互联网公司发起的。

rows.s: It " has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents."
rows.zh: 它“有可能消除一整类专利”。

rows.s: In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents.
rows.zh: 此举令知识产权律师们议论纷纷，联邦巡回上诉法院表示，它将利用一个具体案件对商业方法专利进行广泛审查。

rows.s: In re Bilski, as the case is known, is "a very big deal", says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law.
rows.zh: 密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇说，这个被称为“In re Bilski”的案件是“一件大事”。

rows.s: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
rows.zh: 对商业方法权利主张加以限制将是一个戏剧性的转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院自己通过其在所谓“道富银行案”中的1998年裁决引入了此类专利，该裁决批准了一项关于汇集共同基金资产方法的专利。

rows.s: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
rows.zh: 后来，较为成熟的公司也争相把此类专利加入自己的档案，哪怕只是作为防范竞争对手抢先一步的一种防御性举措。

rows.s: Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
rows.zh: 同样，一些华尔街投资公司也用金融产品专利武装自己，即便它们在法庭案件中持反对这种做法的立场。

rows.s: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for "inventions" that are obvious.
rows.zh: 例如，去年四月，大法官们暗示，太多专利被授予了那些显而易见的“发明”。

rows.s: Now the nation's top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
rows.zh: 如今，全国最高专利法院看来已完全准备好缩减商业方法专利的范围，这类专利自十年前首次获批以来便一直饱受争议。

rows.s: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
rows.zh: 一位发明者为一项抬箱子的技术申请了专利。

rows.s: Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.
rows.zh: 美林为一种资产配置策略获得了法律保护。

rows.s: Amazon.com received one for its "one-click" online payment system.
rows.zh: 亚马逊为其“一键”在线支付系统获得了一项专利。
